beats.textEn: The lords all honoured Xuanyuan as Son of Heaven in place of Shennong: this was the Yellow Emperor.
beats.sourceTitle: Shiji, Annals of the Five Emperors
beats.evidenceNote: 《五帝本纪》“诸侯咸尊轩辕为天子”。

facts.textZh: 黄帝出现在“涿鹿之战”之中。
facts.textEn: The Yellow Emperor levies the lords' troops and fights Chiyou in the wilds of Zhuolu.
facts.sourceTitle: Shiji, Annals of the Five Emperors
facts.sourceLocation: Wu di ben ji (與蚩尤戰於涿鹿之野)

facts.textZh: 黄帝——情节：trains troops while Shennong's rule declines
facts.textEn: As the house of Shennong declines and the lords attack one another, Xuanyuan trains troops to punish those who do not bring tribute.
facts.sourceTitle: Shiji, Annals of the Five Emperors
facts.sourceLocation: Wu di ben ji, Shennong decline passage

deityStoryCards.name: Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea
deityStoryCards.hookEn: Dragon King of the Eastern Sea in Ming novels: he yields the ocean-fixing iron to Sun Wukong in Journey to the West and quarrels with Nezha in Investiture of the Gods.

beats.headingEn: A stone gives birth to a monkey
beats.textZh: 东胜神洲傲来国的海外，有一座花果山，山顶上立着一块仙石。这块石头高三丈六尺五寸，围圆二丈四尺，自开天辟地以来就吸收着天地的灵气和日月的精华，久而久之有了灵通。有一天，仙石崩裂，生出一枚石卵，石卵被风一吹，化成一只石猴，五官俱全，四肢皆备。石猴学会了爬和走，向四方拜了一拜，两只眼睛里射出两道金光，直冲天上的斗府。玉皇大帝被惊动，派千里眼和顺风耳打开南天门查看。两位神将回报说：那是花果山上仙石生出的一只猴子，如今他吃了东西、喝了水，金光就要渐渐消退了。玉帝听了说：下方之物，都是天地精华所生，不足为奇。——谁也没想到，这只猴子后来会把天宫闹得天翻地覆。
beats.textEn: Beyond the sea from the land of Aolai on the Eastern Continent stands the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, and on its summit an immortal stone that had absorbed the essences of heaven and earth since the world began. One day it split open and released a stone egg; touched by the wind, the egg became a stone monkey. He bowed to the four quarters and beams of golden light shot from his eyes to the palace of the Pole Star. The Jade Emperor sent Thousand-Mile Eye and Wind-Following Ear to look; told it was only a monkey born of a stone, he declared such things unremarkable.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: King of the Water Curtain Cave
beats.textZh: 石猴在山中和群猴一起玩耍，饿了吃草木果实，渴了喝山涧泉水。一个炎热的夏天，群猴在涧中洗澡，想去看看这股水从哪里来，便顺着山涧往上爬，一直找到一道大瀑布前。群猴拍手说：谁能钻进瀑布，找到源头又不伤身体，我们就拜他为王！石猴应声而出，闭上眼睛纵身一跳，竟穿过了瀑布。瀑布后面是一座铁板桥，桥那边是一处天造地设的洞府，石锅石灶、石床石凳一应俱全，石碣上刻着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”。石猴跳出来把群猴都领了进去，群猴依约向他跪拜，称他为“美猴王”。从此他去掉“石”字，自称“千岁大王”，在水帘洞里过了三五百年自在的日子。
beats.textEn: The monkey played among the other monkeys of the mountain. One hot summer they followed a stream up to a great waterfall and promised to make king whoever could pass through it unharmed. The stone monkey shut his eyes and leapt through. Behind the falling water lay an iron bridge and a cave-home furnished by nature with stone pots, beds and benches, and an inscription naming it the Water Curtain Cave of the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. He led the monkeys inside, they bowed to him as the Handsome Monkey King, and he lived there freely for three or five hundred years.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 有一天，美猴王和群猴正在饮宴，他忽然流下泪来。群猴问他为何烦恼，他说：我们现在虽然不受人间王法管束，也不怕飞禽走兽，可将来年老血衰，暗中有阎王老子管着，一旦死去，岂不白白在世上走了一遭？群猴听了，也都掩面悲啼。这时一只通背猿猴跳出来说：大王能想到这一层，就是道心开发了。五虫之中，只有三等名色不归阎王管——就是佛、仙与神圣，他们躲过轮回，与天地山川同寿。美猴王大喜，决心云游海角，去寻访这三等人物，学一个长生不老的法子。第二天，群猴摘来仙桃异果为他送行，他独自砍了松木扎成木筏，拿一根竹竿当篙，漂洋过海而去。
beats.textEn: One day at a feast the Monkey King suddenly wept. Though no human law ruled them and no beast threatened them, he said, one day they would grow old and the King of the Dead would claim them. An old gibbon told him that only buddhas, immortals and sages escape the wheel of rebirth. Overjoyed, the Monkey King resolved to find them and learn the way to live forever. The next morning the monkeys feasted him with fruit, and he set off alone across the ocean on a raft of pine logs with a bamboo pole.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: The Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars
beats.textZh: 木筏被风吹到南赡部洲。美猴王上岸学人说话、穿人衣服，在市井里走了八九年，看到的都是为名为利奔忙的人，没有一个修仙的。他又扎筏渡过西洋大海，来到西牛贺洲。在一座高山上，他听见一个樵夫唱着仙家的歌，樵夫说歌是邻居一位神仙教的，那位神仙住在灵台方寸山，斜月三星洞，名叫须菩提祖师。美猴王找到洞门，等了半天，一个仙童开门迎他进去。祖师问他姓什么，他说“我无性，人若骂我，我也不恼”；又问籍贯，他说从东胜神洲来。祖师看他像个猢狲，便把“猢狲”去掉兽旁，给他姓“孙”，再按门中“广大智慧真如性海颖悟圆觉”十二字排到“悟”字，取名“孙悟空”。
beats.textEn: The raft carried him to the Southern Continent, where for eight or nine years he learned human speech and dress but met only people chasing fame and profit. Crossing another ocean to the Western Continent, he heard a woodcutter singing an immortal's song and was directed to the Patriarch Subodhi of the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars on the Mountain of Mind. The patriarch, seeing a monkey (husun), gave him the surname Sun by removing the animal radical, and from the generation character wu named him Sun Wukong, 'Awakened to Emptiness'.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A secret lesson at the third watch
beats.textZh: 悟空在洞中扫地、挑水、砍柴，一住就是六七年。有一天祖师登坛讲道，问他想学什么：讲术、流、静、动各门，可以请仙问卜、读经念佛、打坐参禅、采阴补阳，悟空每听一门都先问一句“能长生吗”，听说不能，就一概不学。祖师假装发怒，跳下高台，拿戒尺在他头上打了三下，背着手走进里屋，关上了中门。众师兄都埋怨他，悟空却心里明白：打三下，是叫他三更时分去；背着手进去、关中门，是叫他从后门进来。当夜三更，他果然从后门溜进祖师卧房跪下。祖师见他领悟了哑谜，便把长生妙道的口诀传给他。三年之后，祖师又说修成的人每五百年要遭雷灾、火灾、风灾，便教他躲灾的七十二般地煞变化；后来又传他一个筋斗云，一翻就是十万八千里。
beats.textEn: Wukong swept, fetched water and cut wood for six or seven years. When the patriarch offered him various arts, he refused each because none brought eternal life. Feigning anger, the patriarch struck him three times on the head, clasped his hands behind his back and shut the inner door. Wukong understood the riddle: come at the third watch, by the back door. That night the patriarch taught him the secret of long life, later the seventy-two earthly transformations to escape the calamities that strike immortals every five hundred years, and finally the somersault cloud that carries him 108,000 li in a single leap.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 一天傍晚，众师兄围着悟空，要看他学来的变化。悟空经不住夸，捻着诀念动咒语，摇身一变，就变成一棵松树，众人齐声喝彩。吵闹声惊动了祖师，祖师把悟空叫来责备：修行之人不可在人前卖弄，别人见了要求你，你不教就会招来祸患。他命悟空立刻离开，并且叮嘱：此去无论惹出什么祸来，都不许说是我的徒弟，你只要说出半个字来，我就把你神魂贬在九幽之处。悟空含泪拜别，一个筋斗回到花果山。他得知一个混世魔王趁他不在，霸占了水帘洞、掳走了小猴，便找上门去，拔一把毫毛变出几百个小猴，把魔王打死，夺回了洞府。
beats.textEn: One evening his fellow students begged to see his new powers, and Wukong turned himself into a pine tree to their loud applause. The patriarch, disturbed by the noise, rebuked him: an adept must not show off, for others will covet the art and trouble will follow. He sent Wukong away at once, forbidding him ever to name his teacher. Wukong somersaulted home, found that a Demon King of Confusion had seized his cave, plucked a handful of hairs that became hundreds of little monkeys, and killed the demon.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A weapon from the Dragon King
beats.textZh: 悟空操练群猴，却没有一件称手的兵器。他得知花果山下的铁板桥直通东海龙宫，便捻着闭水诀钻进水里，向东海龙王敖广讨兵器。龙王先后拿出一把大刀、一柄重三千六百斤的九股叉、一杆重七千二百斤的方天画戟，悟空都嫌太轻。龙婆、龙女出主意说：海藏里那块天河定底的神珍铁，这几天霞光艳艳，莫非是该出世遇此圣人？悟空过去一看，是一根斗来粗、二丈多长的铁柱，两头是金箍，中间刻着“如意金箍棒，重一万三千五百斤”。他说声“再短细些”，铁棒就随心变小，最后成了绣花针大小，藏进耳朵里。他又逼着四海龙王凑出藕丝步云履、锁子黄金甲和凤翅紫金冠，才心满意足地回山。
beats.textEn: Needing a weapon, Wukong dived to the Crystal Palace of Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea. A broadsword, a nine-pronged fork of 3,600 pounds and a halberd of 7,200 pounds were all too light. The Dragon Queen suggested the divine iron that had fixed the depth of the Milky Way, which had lately been glowing. It was a pillar inscribed 'Compliant Golden-Hooped Rod, weight 13,500 pounds', and it shrank at his command until it was the size of an embroidery needle, which he kept behind his ear. He then bullied the dragon kings of the four seas into giving him cloud-walking shoes, golden mail and a phoenix-feather cap.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Striking out the Register of Death
beats.textZh: 悟空回山后，又与牛魔王等六位妖王结为兄弟，天天宴饮。一天他喝醉了，在松树下睡着，梦见两个人拿着勾魂的牌子，用绳子套住他的魂魄，一直拉到幽冥界。悟空看见城上写着“幽冥界”，大怒道：我老孙早已超出三界之外，跳出五行之中，凭什么来勾我？他从耳中掏出金箍棒，把两个勾死人打成肉酱，一路打进森罗殿。十殿阎王只好叫判官拿出生死簿给他看。悟空翻到“魂字一千三百五十号”，上面写着“孙悟空，天产石猴，该寿三百四十二岁，善终”。他索性拿笔把自己和猴类的名字一概勾掉，扔下簿子打出幽冥界。醒来后，东海龙王和地府的秦广王先后上表天庭，状告这只妖猴。
beats.textEn: After a drunken feast with six demon kings, Wukong dreamed that two summoners roped his soul and dragged it to the Land of Darkness. Furious — had he not passed beyond the Three Realms? — he beat them to pulp with his staff and stormed the palace of the Ten Kings of the Underworld. There he found his own entry, 'Sun Wukong, stone monkey born of heaven, allotted 342 years, to die a good death', and with a brush struck out his name and those of all monkeys. When he woke, the Dragon King and the King Qinguang of the underworld each sent complaints to heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingZh: 天庭的第一份官职：弼马温
beats.headingEn: Heaven's first office: Keeper of the Horses
beats.textZh: 玉帝看了两道表文，正要派兵捉拿，太白金星出班奏道：这猴子是天地育成之体，不如降一道招安圣旨，把他宣上天来，给他一个官职，拘束在此，若他受天命，以后再加升赏；若违天命，就地擒拿。玉帝准奏。悟空欢喜上天，被封为御马监的弼马温。他尽心尽力，半个月里把天马养得肉肥膘满。一天同僚设宴，他问起弼马温是几品官，众人说：这官没有品从，叫作“未入流”，养得好不过是一声“好”，养瘦了还要受罚。悟空听了大怒：老孙在花果山称王称祖，怎么骗我来替他养马！他推倒公案，掣出铁棒，一路打出南天门，回到花果山。独角鬼王献上赭黄袍，劝他索性做个“齐天大圣”。
beats.textEn: As the Jade Emperor prepared to send troops, the Gold Star of Venus advised him to summon the monkey with a decree of amnesty and keep him in heaven under a title. Wukong happily accepted and was appointed Keeper of the Heavenly Horses, tending them so well that they grew sleek within a fortnight. At a banquet he learned that the post had no rank at all. Enraged at having been tricked into grooming horses, he overturned his desk, fought his way out through the Southern Gate and returned home, where a demon king urged him to proclaim himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 悟空在洞门外竖起一面大旗，上书“齐天大圣”四个大字。玉帝派托塔李天王和哪吒三太子带领天兵下界捉拿。先锋巨灵神挥着宣花斧上阵，被悟空一棒打断斧柄，败回营中。哪吒变出三头六臂，持六般兵器来战，悟空也变三头六臂，又拔一根毫毛变作本相迎敌，真身绕到背后，一棒打中哪吒的左臂，哪吒负痛败走。李天王只好收兵回奏。太白金星又出主意：不如就封他个空衔“齐天大圣”，有官无禄，养在天地之间，收他的邪心。玉帝依从，在蟠桃园右首给他盖了一座齐天大圣府，府里还设了安静司、宁神司两个衙门。悟空这才欢天喜地，在天上住了下来。
beats.textEn: Wukong raised a banner reading 'Great Sage Equal to Heaven'. The Jade Emperor sent Heavenly King Li and his son Nezha with heaven's soldiers. The vanguard, the Mighty Spirit, had his axe-handle snapped by one blow; Nezha took three heads and six arms, but Wukong did the same, sent a hair-double to fight, and struck Nezha from behind. Venus advised granting the empty title Great Sage Equal to Heaven, with no salary, to quiet the monkey's heart. A mansion was built for him beside the Peach Garden, complete with Offices of Peace and Serenity, and Wukong settled happily in heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 大圣在天上无事可做，今天东游，明天西荡，和众星宿称兄道弟。许旌阳真人担心他闲中生事，玉帝便派他去管理蟠桃园。土地告诉他：园里共有三千六百株桃树——前面一千二百株，三千年一熟，人吃了成仙了道；中间一千二百株，六千年一熟，人吃了霞举飞升、长生不老；后面一千二百株，九千年一熟，人吃了与天地齐寿、日月同庚。大圣听了暗暗高兴，从此常常支开土地和力士，自己脱下冠服爬上大树，拣那熟透的大桃子吃个饱。有一天，王母娘娘要开蟠桃盛会，派七位仙女提着花篮来园中摘桃。大圣正变成二寸长的小人在树梢上睡觉，被惊醒后问仙女都请了谁，仙女一一说来，却没有他。
beats.textEn: With nothing to do, the Great Sage wandered heaven befriending stars. To keep him occupied the Jade Emperor put him in charge of the Garden of Immortal Peaches, whose 3,600 trees ripened every three, six and nine thousand years, granting immortality, eternal youth and a life as long as heaven and earth. Secretly delighted, he sent his attendants away and gorged on the ripest fruit. When seven fairy maidens came to pick peaches for the Queen Mother's Peach Banquet, they woke him from a nap in the treetops — and he learned that he had not been invited.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Stolen wine, stolen elixir and heaven's army
beats.textZh: 大圣用定身法把七位仙女定在树下，驾云直奔瑶池。宴席已经摆好，他拔毫毛变出瞌睡虫，叫造酒的力士都睡着了，自己端起玉液琼浆喝了个酩酊大醉。醉醺醺的他走错了路，闯进太上老君的兜率宫，宫中无人，只见丹房里摆着五个葫芦，装满炼好的金丹。他想：这是仙家至宝，我且尝尝。于是把葫芦里的金丹倒出来，像吃炒豆一样全吃了。酒醒之后，他知道闯了大祸，连忙逃出西天门，回到花果山。玉帝大怒，派四大天王、李天王、哪吒，率领二十八宿、九曜星官、十二元辰等十万天兵，布下十八架天罗地网围住花果山。大圣带着群猴迎战，一连打败九曜星和四大天王，到天黑也没有被捉住。
beats.textEn: Freezing the fairies with an immobilising spell, the Great Sage flew to the Jade Pool, put the wine-makers to sleep with sleep-insects made from his hairs and drank himself senseless. Staggering the wrong way, he wandered into Laozi's Tushita Palace and ate the five gourds of finished elixir pills as if they were roasted beans. Sobering in alarm, he fled home. The Jade Emperor sent the Four Heavenly Kings, Heavenly King Li, Nezha, the twenty-eight lunar mansions and the nine planets with a hundred thousand soldiers and eighteen nets around the mountain, yet the Great Sage held them off until nightfall.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 观音菩萨赴蟠桃会，听说此事，先派徒弟惠岸行者下界交战，也败了回来。观音便向玉帝推荐玉帝的外甥——住在灌江口的显圣二郎真君。二郎神带着梅山六兄弟和哮天犬来到花果山，和大圣大战三百余回合，不分胜负，各自变成万丈高的法身相斗。猴群溃散，大圣心慌，收了法相变成一只麻雀飞上树梢；二郎就变成饿鹰去扑他。大圣变成大鹚老冲天飞去，二郎变成海鹤追赶；他变鱼钻进水里，二郎变鱼鹰候着；他变水蛇，二郎变灰鹤；他变成一只低贱的花鸨，二郎不屑追，用弹弓把他打落。大圣滚到山崖下又变成一座土地庙，嘴变庙门，牙变门扇，舌头变菩萨，尾巴没处放，竖在后面变成一根旗杆，被二郎一眼识破。最后太上老君在云端丢下金刚琢，正打在大圣头上，哮天犬扑上来咬住他的腿，大圣才被众神按倒擒住。
beats.textEn: Guanyin recommended the Jade Emperor's nephew, the Illustrious Sage Erlang of Guanjiang. With his six sworn brothers and his celestial hound, Erlang fought the Great Sage for over three hundred rounds. When the monkeys scattered, the Great Sage fled through transformation after transformation — sparrow, cormorant, fish, water snake, bustard — and Erlang matched each as hawk, crane, osprey and grey crane. Disguised as a temple, the monkey could not hide his tail and stood it up behind as a flagpole, which gave him away. At last Laozi dropped his Diamond Snare on his head, the hound bit his leg, and he was seized.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Fiery golden eyes in the Eight Trigrams furnace
beats.textZh: 大圣被押到斩妖台，绑在降妖柱上。天兵刀砍斧剁、枪刺剑刳，火部众神放火烧、雷部众神用雷劈，竟伤不了他一根毫毛。太上老君说：这猴子吃了蟠桃、喝了御酒，又盗吃了我的金丹，炼成了金刚之躯。不如交给我，放进八卦炉里，用文武火锻炼，炼出我的丹来，他的身体自然化为灰烬。大圣被推进八卦炉，他钻进巽宫位下——巽是风，有风就没有火，只是被烟熏红了眼睛，从此有了一双“火眼金睛”。四十九天后，老君开炉取丹，大圣忽地跳了出来，一脚蹬倒八卦炉，炉砖带着火掉落凡间。他掏出金箍棒，从兜率宫一路打到灵霄殿外，九曜星闭门闭户，四天王无影无踪，只有王灵官举着金鞭拦住了他。
beats.textEn: Bound at the execution terrace, the Great Sage could not be hurt by sword, axe, fire or thunder: the peaches, wine and elixir had made his body adamantine. Laozi had him placed in his Eight Trigrams furnace to be refined for forty-nine days. Hiding under the trigram of wind, where there is no fire, he was only smoked — which reddened his eyes into 'fiery golden eyes'. When the furnace was opened he sprang out, kicked it over so that its burning bricks fell to earth, and fought his way to the Hall of Divine Mists, where only the officer Wang Lingguan stood against him.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 王灵官和三十六员雷将把大圣团团围住，大圣变出三头六臂，把金箍棒幌一幌变成三根，六只手使开，打得雷将们近不了身。玉帝只好派游弈灵官和翊圣真君到西方去请如来佛祖。如来来到灵霄殿外，叫雷将停手，问大圣：你有什么本事，敢夺玉帝的尊位？大圣说：“皇帝轮流做，明年到我家”，只要玉帝把天宫让给他就罢了。如来笑道：我和你打个赌——你若一个筋斗翻得出我的右手掌，就算你赢，请玉帝到西方居住，天宫让给你；若翻不出去，你就回下界做妖，再修几劫来争。大圣暗笑：我一个筋斗十万八千里，他的手掌不满一尺，怎么跳不出去？他跳上佛掌，一个筋斗云不见踪影，只见天边立着五根肉红柱子，便以为到了天的尽头。
beats.textEn: Surrounded by Wang Lingguan and thirty-six thunder generals, the Great Sage fought them off with three heads, six arms and three staffs, until the Jade Emperor sent to the West for Rulai. Asked what right he had to the throne, the Great Sage replied that emperors take turns — next year it would be his. Rulai offered a wager: if he could somersault out of Rulai's right palm, the Jade Emperor would yield heaven; if not, he must return below. Scoffing that his somersault covered 108,000 li, the Great Sage leapt — and came to five flesh-pink pillars he took to be the edge of the sky.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Under the Mountain of Five Elements
beats.textZh: 大圣心想：我到了这里，回去跟如来做个凭证。他拔一根毫毛变出一支浓墨双毫笔，在中间那根柱子上写下一行大字：“齐天大圣到此一游”。写完收了毫毛，又不庄重地在第一根柱子下撒了一泡猴尿，然后翻转筋斗回到原处，对如来说：我已经去了又回来了，你叫玉帝让出天宫吧！如来骂道：你这尿精猴子，你正好不曾离开我的手掌！你低头看看。大圣一看，如来右手中指上写着“齐天大圣到此一游”，大拇指根下还有一股猴尿的臊气。他大吃一惊，正要再跳，被如来翻掌一扑，推出西天门外，五根手指化作金、木、水、火、土五座相连的大山，叫作“五行山”，把他压在山下。众神在天宫摆了“安天大会”答谢如来。如来又取出写着“唵、嘛、呢、叭、咪、吽”六个金字的帖子，贴在山顶，并嘱咐当地的土地神：他饿了就给他吃铁丸子，渴了就给他喝熔化的铜汁。等他的灾难满了，自然会有人来救他。——这一压，就是五百年。
beats.textEn: To prove his journey he made a brush from a hair, wrote 'The Great Sage Equal to Heaven was here' on the middle pillar, and relieved himself at the foot of the first. Somersaulting back, he demanded the throne. Rulai showed him the words written on his own middle finger and the smell of monkey urine at the base of his thumb. Before the monkey could leap again, Rulai pushed him out of the Western Gate and turned his five fingers into the five joined peaks of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth — the Mountain of Five Elements — sealed with a golden six-syllable charm. The local god was to feed him iron pellets and molten copper until, five hundred years later, someone would come to free him.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)
beats.uncertaintyNote: “五百年”的时间与后来唐僧解救的情节见于第八回之后，本篇只讲到被压为止。

facts.textZh: 东海龙王敖广——情节：vows to accuse Li Jing and Nezha before the Jade Emperor
facts.textEn: Ao Guang comes to Chentang Pass in human form, finds Nezha braiding his son's sinew, and vows to accuse Li Jing and Nezha before the Jade Emperor.
facts.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

deityStoryCards.name: Erlang Shen
deityStoryCards.hookEn: The Illustrious Sage Erlang of Guanjiang, the Jade Emperor's nephew in Journey to the West, who outmatches Sun Wukong in transformations.

beats.headingEn: A stone gives birth to a monkey
beats.textZh: 东胜神洲傲来国的海外，有一座花果山，山顶上立着一块仙石。这块石头高三丈六尺五寸，围圆二丈四尺，自开天辟地以来就吸收着天地的灵气和日月的精华，久而久之有了灵通。有一天，仙石崩裂，生出一枚石卵，石卵被风一吹，化成一只石猴，五官俱全，四肢皆备。石猴学会了爬和走，向四方拜了一拜，两只眼睛里射出两道金光，直冲天上的斗府。玉皇大帝被惊动，派千里眼和顺风耳打开南天门查看。两位神将回报说：那是花果山上仙石生出的一只猴子，如今他吃了东西、喝了水，金光就要渐渐消退了。玉帝听了说：下方之物，都是天地精华所生，不足为奇。——谁也没想到，这只猴子后来会把天宫闹得天翻地覆。
beats.textEn: Beyond the sea from the land of Aolai on the Eastern Continent stands the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, and on its summit an immortal stone that had absorbed the essences of heaven and earth since the world began. One day it split open and released a stone egg; touched by the wind, the egg became a stone monkey. He bowed to the four quarters and beams of golden light shot from his eyes to the palace of the Pole Star. The Jade Emperor sent Thousand-Mile Eye and Wind-Following Ear to look; told it was only a monkey born of a stone, he declared such things unremarkable.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: King of the Water Curtain Cave
beats.textZh: 石猴在山中和群猴一起玩耍，饿了吃草木果实，渴了喝山涧泉水。一个炎热的夏天，群猴在涧中洗澡，想去看看这股水从哪里来，便顺着山涧往上爬，一直找到一道大瀑布前。群猴拍手说：谁能钻进瀑布，找到源头又不伤身体，我们就拜他为王！石猴应声而出，闭上眼睛纵身一跳，竟穿过了瀑布。瀑布后面是一座铁板桥，桥那边是一处天造地设的洞府，石锅石灶、石床石凳一应俱全，石碣上刻着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”。石猴跳出来把群猴都领了进去，群猴依约向他跪拜，称他为“美猴王”。从此他去掉“石”字，自称“千岁大王”，在水帘洞里过了三五百年自在的日子。
beats.textEn: The monkey played among the other monkeys of the mountain. One hot summer they followed a stream up to a great waterfall and promised to make king whoever could pass through it unharmed. The stone monkey shut his eyes and leapt through. Behind the falling water lay an iron bridge and a cave-home furnished by nature with stone pots, beds and benches, and an inscription naming it the Water Curtain Cave of the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. He led the monkeys inside, they bowed to him as the Handsome Monkey King, and he lived there freely for three or five hundred years.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 有一天，美猴王和群猴正在饮宴，他忽然流下泪来。群猴问他为何烦恼，他说：我们现在虽然不受人间王法管束，也不怕飞禽走兽，可将来年老血衰，暗中有阎王老子管着，一旦死去，岂不白白在世上走了一遭？群猴听了，也都掩面悲啼。这时一只通背猿猴跳出来说：大王能想到这一层，就是道心开发了。五虫之中，只有三等名色不归阎王管——就是佛、仙与神圣，他们躲过轮回，与天地山川同寿。美猴王大喜，决心云游海角，去寻访这三等人物，学一个长生不老的法子。第二天，群猴摘来仙桃异果为他送行，他独自砍了松木扎成木筏，拿一根竹竿当篙，漂洋过海而去。
beats.textEn: One day at a feast the Monkey King suddenly wept. Though no human law ruled them and no beast threatened them, he said, one day they would grow old and the King of the Dead would claim them. An old gibbon told him that only buddhas, immortals and sages escape the wheel of rebirth. Overjoyed, the Monkey King resolved to find them and learn the way to live forever. The next morning the monkeys feasted him with fruit, and he set off alone across the ocean on a raft of pine logs with a bamboo pole.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: The Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars
beats.textZh: 木筏被风吹到南赡部洲。美猴王上岸学人说话、穿人衣服，在市井里走了八九年，看到的都是为名为利奔忙的人，没有一个修仙的。他又扎筏渡过西洋大海，来到西牛贺洲。在一座高山上，他听见一个樵夫唱着仙家的歌，樵夫说歌是邻居一位神仙教的，那位神仙住在灵台方寸山，斜月三星洞，名叫须菩提祖师。美猴王找到洞门，等了半天，一个仙童开门迎他进去。祖师问他姓什么，他说“我无性，人若骂我，我也不恼”；又问籍贯，他说从东胜神洲来。祖师看他像个猢狲，便把“猢狲”去掉兽旁，给他姓“孙”，再按门中“广大智慧真如性海颖悟圆觉”十二字排到“悟”字，取名“孙悟空”。
beats.textEn: The raft carried him to the Southern Continent, where for eight or nine years he learned human speech and dress but met only people chasing fame and profit. Crossing another ocean to the Western Continent, he heard a woodcutter singing an immortal's song and was directed to the Patriarch Subodhi of the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars on the Mountain of Mind. The patriarch, seeing a monkey (husun), gave him the surname Sun by removing the animal radical, and from the generation character wu named him Sun Wukong, 'Awakened to Emptiness'.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A secret lesson at the third watch
beats.textZh: 悟空在洞中扫地、挑水、砍柴，一住就是六七年。有一天祖师登坛讲道，问他想学什么：讲术、流、静、动各门，可以请仙问卜、读经念佛、打坐参禅、采阴补阳，悟空每听一门都先问一句“能长生吗”，听说不能，就一概不学。祖师假装发怒，跳下高台，拿戒尺在他头上打了三下，背着手走进里屋，关上了中门。众师兄都埋怨他，悟空却心里明白：打三下，是叫他三更时分去；背着手进去、关中门，是叫他从后门进来。当夜三更，他果然从后门溜进祖师卧房跪下。祖师见他领悟了哑谜，便把长生妙道的口诀传给他。三年之后，祖师又说修成的人每五百年要遭雷灾、火灾、风灾，便教他躲灾的七十二般地煞变化；后来又传他一个筋斗云，一翻就是十万八千里。
beats.textEn: Wukong swept, fetched water and cut wood for six or seven years. When the patriarch offered him various arts, he refused each because none brought eternal life. Feigning anger, the patriarch struck him three times on the head, clasped his hands behind his back and shut the inner door. Wukong understood the riddle: come at the third watch, by the back door. That night the patriarch taught him the secret of long life, later the seventy-two earthly transformations to escape the calamities that strike immortals every five hundred years, and finally the somersault cloud that carries him 108,000 li in a single leap.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 一天傍晚，众师兄围着悟空，要看他学来的变化。悟空经不住夸，捻着诀念动咒语，摇身一变，就变成一棵松树，众人齐声喝彩。吵闹声惊动了祖师，祖师把悟空叫来责备：修行之人不可在人前卖弄，别人见了要求你，你不教就会招来祸患。他命悟空立刻离开，并且叮嘱：此去无论惹出什么祸来，都不许说是我的徒弟，你只要说出半个字来，我就把你神魂贬在九幽之处。悟空含泪拜别，一个筋斗回到花果山。他得知一个混世魔王趁他不在，霸占了水帘洞、掳走了小猴，便找上门去，拔一把毫毛变出几百个小猴，把魔王打死，夺回了洞府。
beats.textEn: One evening his fellow students begged to see his new powers, and Wukong turned himself into a pine tree to their loud applause. The patriarch, disturbed by the noise, rebuked him: an adept must not show off, for others will covet the art and trouble will follow. He sent Wukong away at once, forbidding him ever to name his teacher. Wukong somersaulted home, found that a Demon King of Confusion had seized his cave, plucked a handful of hairs that became hundreds of little monkeys, and killed the demon.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A weapon from the Dragon King
beats.textZh: 悟空操练群猴，却没有一件称手的兵器。他得知花果山下的铁板桥直通东海龙宫，便捻着闭水诀钻进水里，向东海龙王敖广讨兵器。龙王先后拿出一把大刀、一柄重三千六百斤的九股叉、一杆重七千二百斤的方天画戟，悟空都嫌太轻。龙婆、龙女出主意说：海藏里那块天河定底的神珍铁，这几天霞光艳艳，莫非是该出世遇此圣人？悟空过去一看，是一根斗来粗、二丈多长的铁柱，两头是金箍，中间刻着“如意金箍棒，重一万三千五百斤”。他说声“再短细些”，铁棒就随心变小，最后成了绣花针大小，藏进耳朵里。他又逼着四海龙王凑出藕丝步云履、锁子黄金甲和凤翅紫金冠，才心满意足地回山。
beats.textEn: Needing a weapon, Wukong dived to the Crystal Palace of Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea. A broadsword, a nine-pronged fork of 3,600 pounds and a halberd of 7,200 pounds were all too light. The Dragon Queen suggested the divine iron that had fixed the depth of the Milky Way, which had lately been glowing. It was a pillar inscribed 'Compliant Golden-Hooped Rod, weight 13,500 pounds', and it shrank at his command until it was the size of an embroidery needle, which he kept behind his ear. He then bullied the dragon kings of the four seas into giving him cloud-walking shoes, golden mail and a phoenix-feather cap.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Striking out the Register of Death
beats.textZh: 悟空回山后，又与牛魔王等六位妖王结为兄弟，天天宴饮。一天他喝醉了，在松树下睡着，梦见两个人拿着勾魂的牌子，用绳子套住他的魂魄，一直拉到幽冥界。悟空看见城上写着“幽冥界”，大怒道：我老孙早已超出三界之外，跳出五行之中，凭什么来勾我？他从耳中掏出金箍棒，把两个勾死人打成肉酱，一路打进森罗殿。十殿阎王只好叫判官拿出生死簿给他看。悟空翻到“魂字一千三百五十号”，上面写着“孙悟空，天产石猴，该寿三百四十二岁，善终”。他索性拿笔把自己和猴类的名字一概勾掉，扔下簿子打出幽冥界。醒来后，东海龙王和地府的秦广王先后上表天庭，状告这只妖猴。
beats.textEn: After a drunken feast with six demon kings, Wukong dreamed that two summoners roped his soul and dragged it to the Land of Darkness. Furious — had he not passed beyond the Three Realms? — he beat them to pulp with his staff and stormed the palace of the Ten Kings of the Underworld. There he found his own entry, 'Sun Wukong, stone monkey born of heaven, allotted 342 years, to die a good death', and with a brush struck out his name and those of all monkeys. When he woke, the Dragon King and the King Qinguang of the underworld each sent complaints to heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingZh: 天庭的第一份官职：弼马温
beats.headingEn: Heaven's first office: Keeper of the Horses
beats.textZh: 玉帝看了两道表文，正要派兵捉拿，太白金星出班奏道：这猴子是天地育成之体，不如降一道招安圣旨，把他宣上天来，给他一个官职，拘束在此，若他受天命，以后再加升赏；若违天命，就地擒拿。玉帝准奏。悟空欢喜上天，被封为御马监的弼马温。他尽心尽力，半个月里把天马养得肉肥膘满。一天同僚设宴，他问起弼马温是几品官，众人说：这官没有品从，叫作“未入流”，养得好不过是一声“好”，养瘦了还要受罚。悟空听了大怒：老孙在花果山称王称祖，怎么骗我来替他养马！他推倒公案，掣出铁棒，一路打出南天门，回到花果山。独角鬼王献上赭黄袍，劝他索性做个“齐天大圣”。
beats.textEn: As the Jade Emperor prepared to send troops, the Gold Star of Venus advised him to summon the monkey with a decree of amnesty and keep him in heaven under a title. Wukong happily accepted and was appointed Keeper of the Heavenly Horses, tending them so well that they grew sleek within a fortnight. At a banquet he learned that the post had no rank at all. Enraged at having been tricked into grooming horses, he overturned his desk, fought his way out through the Southern Gate and returned home, where a demon king urged him to proclaim himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 悟空在洞门外竖起一面大旗，上书“齐天大圣”四个大字。玉帝派托塔李天王和哪吒三太子带领天兵下界捉拿。先锋巨灵神挥着宣花斧上阵，被悟空一棒打断斧柄，败回营中。哪吒变出三头六臂，持六般兵器来战，悟空也变三头六臂，又拔一根毫毛变作本相迎敌，真身绕到背后，一棒打中哪吒的左臂，哪吒负痛败走。李天王只好收兵回奏。太白金星又出主意：不如就封他个空衔“齐天大圣”，有官无禄，养在天地之间，收他的邪心。玉帝依从，在蟠桃园右首给他盖了一座齐天大圣府，府里还设了安静司、宁神司两个衙门。悟空这才欢天喜地，在天上住了下来。
beats.textEn: Wukong raised a banner reading 'Great Sage Equal to Heaven'. The Jade Emperor sent Heavenly King Li and his son Nezha with heaven's soldiers. The vanguard, the Mighty Spirit, had his axe-handle snapped by one blow; Nezha took three heads and six arms, but Wukong did the same, sent a hair-double to fight, and struck Nezha from behind. Venus advised granting the empty title Great Sage Equal to Heaven, with no salary, to quiet the monkey's heart. A mansion was built for him beside the Peach Garden, complete with Offices of Peace and Serenity, and Wukong settled happily in heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 大圣在天上无事可做，今天东游，明天西荡，和众星宿称兄道弟。许旌阳真人担心他闲中生事，玉帝便派他去管理蟠桃园。土地告诉他：园里共有三千六百株桃树——前面一千二百株，三千年一熟，人吃了成仙了道；中间一千二百株，六千年一熟，人吃了霞举飞升、长生不老；后面一千二百株，九千年一熟，人吃了与天地齐寿、日月同庚。大圣听了暗暗高兴，从此常常支开土地和力士，自己脱下冠服爬上大树，拣那熟透的大桃子吃个饱。有一天，王母娘娘要开蟠桃盛会，派七位仙女提着花篮来园中摘桃。大圣正变成二寸长的小人在树梢上睡觉，被惊醒后问仙女都请了谁，仙女一一说来，却没有他。
beats.textEn: With nothing to do, the Great Sage wandered heaven befriending stars. To keep him occupied the Jade Emperor put him in charge of the Garden of Immortal Peaches, whose 3,600 trees ripened every three, six and nine thousand years, granting immortality, eternal youth and a life as long as heaven and earth. Secretly delighted, he sent his attendants away and gorged on the ripest fruit. When seven fairy maidens came to pick peaches for the Queen Mother's Peach Banquet, they woke him from a nap in the treetops — and he learned that he had not been invited.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Stolen wine, stolen elixir and heaven's army
beats.textZh: 大圣用定身法把七位仙女定在树下，驾云直奔瑶池。宴席已经摆好，他拔毫毛变出瞌睡虫，叫造酒的力士都睡着了，自己端起玉液琼浆喝了个酩酊大醉。醉醺醺的他走错了路，闯进太上老君的兜率宫，宫中无人，只见丹房里摆着五个葫芦，装满炼好的金丹。他想：这是仙家至宝，我且尝尝。于是把葫芦里的金丹倒出来，像吃炒豆一样全吃了。酒醒之后，他知道闯了大祸，连忙逃出西天门，回到花果山。玉帝大怒，派四大天王、李天王、哪吒，率领二十八宿、九曜星官、十二元辰等十万天兵，布下十八架天罗地网围住花果山。大圣带着群猴迎战，一连打败九曜星和四大天王，到天黑也没有被捉住。
beats.textEn: Freezing the fairies with an immobilising spell, the Great Sage flew to the Jade Pool, put the wine-makers to sleep with sleep-insects made from his hairs and drank himself senseless. Staggering the wrong way, he wandered into Laozi's Tushita Palace and ate the five gourds of finished elixir pills as if they were roasted beans. Sobering in alarm, he fled home. The Jade Emperor sent the Four Heavenly Kings, Heavenly King Li, Nezha, the twenty-eight lunar mansions and the nine planets with a hundred thousand soldiers and eighteen nets around the mountain, yet the Great Sage held them off until nightfall.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 观音菩萨赴蟠桃会，听说此事，先派徒弟惠岸行者下界交战，也败了回来。观音便向玉帝推荐玉帝的外甥——住在灌江口的显圣二郎真君。二郎神带着梅山六兄弟和哮天犬来到花果山，和大圣大战三百余回合，不分胜负，各自变成万丈高的法身相斗。猴群溃散，大圣心慌，收了法相变成一只麻雀飞上树梢；二郎就变成饿鹰去扑他。大圣变成大鹚老冲天飞去，二郎变成海鹤追赶；他变鱼钻进水里，二郎变鱼鹰候着；他变水蛇，二郎变灰鹤；他变成一只低贱的花鸨，二郎不屑追，用弹弓把他打落。大圣滚到山崖下又变成一座土地庙，嘴变庙门，牙变门扇，舌头变菩萨，尾巴没处放，竖在后面变成一根旗杆，被二郎一眼识破。最后太上老君在云端丢下金刚琢，正打在大圣头上，哮天犬扑上来咬住他的腿，大圣才被众神按倒擒住。
beats.textEn: Guanyin recommended the Jade Emperor's nephew, the Illustrious Sage Erlang of Guanjiang. With his six sworn brothers and his celestial hound, Erlang fought the Great Sage for over three hundred rounds. When the monkeys scattered, the Great Sage fled through transformation after transformation — sparrow, cormorant, fish, water snake, bustard — and Erlang matched each as hawk, crane, osprey and grey crane. Disguised as a temple, the monkey could not hide his tail and stood it up behind as a flagpole, which gave him away. At last Laozi dropped his Diamond Snare on his head, the hound bit his leg, and he was seized.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Fiery golden eyes in the Eight Trigrams furnace
beats.textZh: 大圣被押到斩妖台，绑在降妖柱上。天兵刀砍斧剁、枪刺剑刳，火部众神放火烧、雷部众神用雷劈，竟伤不了他一根毫毛。太上老君说：这猴子吃了蟠桃、喝了御酒，又盗吃了我的金丹，炼成了金刚之躯。不如交给我，放进八卦炉里，用文武火锻炼，炼出我的丹来，他的身体自然化为灰烬。大圣被推进八卦炉，他钻进巽宫位下——巽是风，有风就没有火，只是被烟熏红了眼睛，从此有了一双“火眼金睛”。四十九天后，老君开炉取丹，大圣忽地跳了出来，一脚蹬倒八卦炉，炉砖带着火掉落凡间。他掏出金箍棒，从兜率宫一路打到灵霄殿外，九曜星闭门闭户，四天王无影无踪，只有王灵官举着金鞭拦住了他。
beats.textEn: Bound at the execution terrace, the Great Sage could not be hurt by sword, axe, fire or thunder: the peaches, wine and elixir had made his body adamantine. Laozi had him placed in his Eight Trigrams furnace to be refined for forty-nine days. Hiding under the trigram of wind, where there is no fire, he was only smoked — which reddened his eyes into 'fiery golden eyes'. When the furnace was opened he sprang out, kicked it over so that its burning bricks fell to earth, and fought his way to the Hall of Divine Mists, where only the officer Wang Lingguan stood against him.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 王灵官和三十六员雷将把大圣团团围住，大圣变出三头六臂，把金箍棒幌一幌变成三根，六只手使开，打得雷将们近不了身。玉帝只好派游弈灵官和翊圣真君到西方去请如来佛祖。如来来到灵霄殿外，叫雷将停手，问大圣：你有什么本事，敢夺玉帝的尊位？大圣说：“皇帝轮流做，明年到我家”，只要玉帝把天宫让给他就罢了。如来笑道：我和你打个赌——你若一个筋斗翻得出我的右手掌，就算你赢，请玉帝到西方居住，天宫让给你；若翻不出去，你就回下界做妖，再修几劫来争。大圣暗笑：我一个筋斗十万八千里，他的手掌不满一尺，怎么跳不出去？他跳上佛掌，一个筋斗云不见踪影，只见天边立着五根肉红柱子，便以为到了天的尽头。
beats.textEn: Surrounded by Wang Lingguan and thirty-six thunder generals, the Great Sage fought them off with three heads, six arms and three staffs, until the Jade Emperor sent to the West for Rulai. Asked what right he had to the throne, the Great Sage replied that emperors take turns — next year it would be his. Rulai offered a wager: if he could somersault out of Rulai's right palm, the Jade Emperor would yield heaven; if not, he must return below. Scoffing that his somersault covered 108,000 li, the Great Sage leapt — and came to five flesh-pink pillars he took to be the edge of the sky.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Under the Mountain of Five Elements
beats.textZh: 大圣心想：我到了这里，回去跟如来做个凭证。他拔一根毫毛变出一支浓墨双毫笔，在中间那根柱子上写下一行大字：“齐天大圣到此一游”。写完收了毫毛，又不庄重地在第一根柱子下撒了一泡猴尿，然后翻转筋斗回到原处，对如来说：我已经去了又回来了，你叫玉帝让出天宫吧！如来骂道：你这尿精猴子，你正好不曾离开我的手掌！你低头看看。大圣一看，如来右手中指上写着“齐天大圣到此一游”，大拇指根下还有一股猴尿的臊气。他大吃一惊，正要再跳，被如来翻掌一扑，推出西天门外，五根手指化作金、木、水、火、土五座相连的大山，叫作“五行山”，把他压在山下。众神在天宫摆了“安天大会”答谢如来。如来又取出写着“唵、嘛、呢、叭、咪、吽”六个金字的帖子，贴在山顶，并嘱咐当地的土地神：他饿了就给他吃铁丸子，渴了就给他喝熔化的铜汁。等他的灾难满了，自然会有人来救他。——这一压，就是五百年。
beats.textEn: To prove his journey he made a brush from a hair, wrote 'The Great Sage Equal to Heaven was here' on the middle pillar, and relieved himself at the foot of the first. Somersaulting back, he demanded the throne. Rulai showed him the words written on his own middle finger and the smell of monkey urine at the base of his thumb. Before the monkey could leap again, Rulai pushed him out of the Western Gate and turned his five fingers into the five joined peaks of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth — the Mountain of Five Elements — sealed with a golden six-syllable charm. The local god was to feed him iron pellets and molten copper until, five hundred years later, someone would come to free him.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)
beats.uncertaintyNote: “五百年”的时间与后来唐僧解救的情节见于第八回之后，本篇只讲到被压为止。

deityStoryCards.name: Nezha
deityStoryCards.hookZh: 《西游记》第四回中托塔李天王的三太子，变三头六臂迎战孙悟空（后世文学层）。
deityStoryCards.hookEn: Third prince of Heavenly King Li in Journey to the West ch. 4, who takes three heads and six arms against Sun Wukong (later literary layer).

beats.textZh: 商朝末年，陈塘关的总兵李靖，曾经拜西昆仑度厄真人为师，学过五行遁术，后来因为仙道难成，下山辅佐纣王，做了镇守一方的总兵。他的夫人殷氏已经生了两个儿子：长子金吒、次子木吒。不料殷夫人第三次怀孕，竟怀了三年零六个月还没有生产。李靖常常对着夫人发愁：怀胎这么久，恐怕不是吉兆。一天夜里，殷夫人梦见一位道人径直走进卧房，说了一声“夫人快接麟儿”，就把一样东西往她怀里一送。夫人猛然惊醒，腹中随即疼痛起来，李靖连忙出去在前厅等候。
beats.textEn: In the last years of the Shang, Li Jing, commander of Chentang Pass, had once studied the arts of the Five Elements with an immortal before coming down the mountain to serve King Zhou. His wife, Lady Yin, had borne two sons, Jinzha and Muzha, but her third pregnancy lasted three years and six months, and Li Jing feared it was an ill omen. One night she dreamed that a Daoist walked into her chamber, said 'Madam, receive your unicorn child', and thrust something into her arms. She woke with labour pains.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A child from a ball of flesh
beats.textZh: 两个侍女慌慌张张跑来报告：夫人生下了一个妖精！李靖急忙提剑进房，只见满屋红光，异香扑鼻，地上一个肉球滴溜溜地乱转。李靖大惊，一剑砍去，肉球分开，跳出一个小孩来：遍体红光，面如傅粉，右手套着一只金镯，肚腹上围着一块红绫，金光射目。这就是乾坤圈和混天绫。孩子满地乱跑，李靖看他相貌可爱，不忍心杀他，抱给夫人看，夫妻俩都十分喜爱。第二天，许多属官都来道贺。
beats.textEn: Maids ran out crying that their mistress had given birth to a monster. Li Jing rushed in with his sword: the room glowed red and smelled of strange perfume, and a ball of flesh was spinning on the floor. He split it with one stroke, and out jumped a little boy glowing red, his face as white as powder, a golden bracelet on his right arm and a red silk sash around his belly flashing golden light — the Universe Ring and the Red Armillary Sash. Charmed despite himself, Li Jing could not bring himself to kill the child.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 第三天，门官来报：外面有一位道人求见。李靖出门迎接，来的是乾元山金光洞的太乙真人。真人说：听说将军生了一位公子，贫道特来贺喜，能否让我看一看？李靖叫人把孩子抱出来。真人看了问：这孩子是什么时辰生的？李靖说是丑时。真人道：不好。原来这孩子是“灵珠子”化身，生在丑时，犯了一千七百条杀戒。他问孩子起了名字没有，李靖说还没有。真人说：我给他起个名字，就叫“哪吒”，收他做我的徒弟，你看如何？李靖连连答应。真人又叮嘱了几句，便告辞回山。
beats.textEn: On the third day a Daoist called: Taiyi Zhenren of the Golden Light Cave on Qianyuan Mountain. Looking at the baby, he asked the hour of birth; told it was the hour of the ox, he said that was unlucky, for the child — an incarnation of the Spirit Pearl — would break the commandment against killing seventeen hundred times. He named the boy Nezha and took him as his disciple, and Li Jing gladly agreed.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Bathing in the Nine Bends River
beats.textZh: 光阴似箭，哪吒长到七岁，身高六尺。这年五月天气炎热，他向母亲禀明，带着一个家将出关游玩。走到一条清澈的九湾河边，他见河水碧绿，便脱了衣服坐在石头上，把七尺长的混天绫放进水里蘸着洗澡。谁知这混天绫是一件宝物，在水里一摆，河水就映红了；再一摆，江河晃动；摇一摇，天地都跟着动。九湾河连着东海，这一洗，东海龙王敖光的水晶宫被晃得乱响，几乎要塌了。
beats.textEn: At seven years old and six feet tall, Nezha went outside the pass one hot day in the fifth month with a servant. At the clear Nine Bends River he sat on a rock and dipped his seven-foot Red Armillary Sash in the water to bathe. But the sash was a treasure: one swish turned the river red, another shook the waters, and further shaking moved heaven and earth. The river flowed into the Eastern Sea, and the Crystal Palace of the Dragon King Ao Guang shook as if it would collapse.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: The yaksha and the third prince
beats.textZh: 龙王派巡海夜叉李艮去看看出了什么事。夜叉分开水面，看见一个小孩在用红绫洗澡，便张口大骂，提起斧头就劈。哪吒闪过，把右手上的乾坤圈往空中一丢，正打在夜叉头上，夜叉脑浆迸流，死在岸上。哪吒还笑着说：把我的乾坤圈都弄脏了。龙王的三太子敖丙听说夜叉被打死，骑着逼水兽，带着虾兵蟹将杀出水面。两人言语不合，敖丙举戟就刺，哪吒把混天绫往空中一展，像一团火块把敖丙裹下兽来，又一乾坤圈打在他的头顶。三太子现出龙的原形，死在岸边。哪吒说：这条龙的筋，正好抽出来给我父亲做一条束甲的绦子。于是把龙筋抽了出来。
beats.textEn: The Dragon King sent the patrolling yaksha Li Gen to investigate. The yaksha cursed the boy and swung his axe; Nezha threw his Universe Ring and killed him with one blow, laughing that the ring was now dirty. The Dragon King's third son, Ao Bing, rode out on a water-parting beast with an army of shrimps and crabs. When he thrust with his halberd, Nezha's sash wrapped him like fire and pulled him down, and the ring struck his head. Ao Bing died in his dragon form, and Nezha pulled out the dragon's sinew to make a belt for his father's armour.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 哪吒回到家里，若无其事。东海龙王敖光得知儿子被杀、龙筋被抽，悲痛万分，化成一个秀士来到陈塘关，要李靖交出凶手。李靖起初不信，说我的儿子才七岁，怎能做出这种事？他到后园去问，哪吒正坐在那里编龙筋绦子，坦然承认，还说是对方先骂人动手。李靖惊得目瞪口呆。敖光看见儿子的龙筋，更加悲愤，说：明天我就上奏玉帝，问你们父子的罪！说完就走了。殷夫人和李靖相对痛哭，哪吒见父母为难，跪下说：这事我自己去承担，我去乾元山问我的师父。
beats.textEn: Ao Guang, grieving for his son, came to Chentang Pass in the form of a scholar and demanded the killer. Li Jing could not believe a seven-year-old had done it, but found Nezha in the back garden calmly braiding the dragon sinew into a belt, readily admitting the deed. The sight enraged the Dragon King, who vowed to report father and son to the Jade Emperor the next day. As his parents wept, Nezha knelt and said he would take responsibility himself and seek his teacher's counsel.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Beating the Dragon King at the Gate of Treasured Virtue
beats.textZh: 哪吒借土遁到乾元山，向太乙真人说明经过。真人想：这是天数注定，并非他有意为之。他让哪吒解开衣服，在他胸前画了一道隐身符，叫他到天上的宝德门外等候龙王。哪吒到了宝德门，天宫的门还没开，他隐着身子等。不一会儿，敖光朝服叮当地来了，哪吒看得见他，他却看不见哪吒。哪吒冲上去，一乾坤圈把他打倒，用脚踏住他的后背，又揭开他的朝服，从左胁下一连揭了四五十片龙鳞，鲜血直流。敖光疼痛难忍，只好求饶，答应不再上告。哪吒叫他变成一条小青蛇，装进袖子里，带回陈塘关去见父亲。
beats.textEn: Nezha travelled underground to his teacher. Taiyi judged the matter fated rather than wilful, drew an invisibility charm on the boy's chest, and sent him to wait outside the Gate of Treasured Virtue in heaven. When Ao Guang arrived in his court robes, unable to see his attacker, Nezha knocked him down with the ring, stood on his back and tore forty or fifty scales from beneath his left ribs. In agony, the Dragon King promised not to complain, and Nezha made him shrink into a little green snake and carried him home in his sleeve.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)
beats.uncertaintyNote: 宝德门一段跨第十二、十三回回末与回首，各刻本分回处略有出入。

beats.headingEn: An arrow kills the Green Cloud boy
beats.textZh: 龙王放回后，怀恨而去。哪吒无事，又到陈塘关的城楼上玩耍，看见架上放着一张乾坤弓和三支震天箭——这是轩辕黄帝传下来的镇关之宝，从来没人拉得开。哪吒拿起来，一拉就开，搭箭向西南方射去。这一箭直飞到骷髅山白骨洞，正射中石矶娘娘门下的碧云童子，童子当场死去。石矶娘娘拔出箭来，见箭上刻着“镇陈塘关总兵李靖”，大怒，驾着青鸾来到陈塘关，先把李靖摄到洞中质问。李靖说明原委，回来叫哪吒去山上请罪。
beats.textEn: Freed, the Dragon King left nursing his grudge. Nezha then climbed the gate tower of the pass, where hung the Universe Bow and three Heaven-Shaking Arrows left by the Yellow Emperor, which no one had ever been able to draw. Nezha drew the bow with ease and shot an arrow to the south-west. It flew all the way to the White Bone Cave on Skull Mountain and killed the Green Cloud boy, disciple of Lady Shiji. Seeing the arrow inscribed with Li Jing's name, she seized him and demanded the culprit.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 哪吒来到骷髅山，和石矶娘娘一言不合就动起手来。石矶法力高强，用八卦云光帕把哪吒的乾坤圈和混天绫都收了去。哪吒抵挡不住，一路逃回乾元山，向师父求救。太乙真人出洞，好言相劝，石矶不肯罢休，挥剑就砍。真人说：既然你要动手，就怪不得我了。他把九龙神火罩往空中一抛，罩住石矶，九条火龙盘绕，烈焰腾腾，把石矶烧出了原形——原来她是一块天地间孕育出来的顽石成精。太乙真人对哪吒说：你快回去，你的父母已经有难了。
beats.textEn: At Skull Mountain Nezha fought Lady Shiji, who caught his ring and sash with her eight-trigram cloud-light kerchief. He fled to his teacher. When she refused to make peace and attacked with her sword, Taiyi threw his Nine-Dragon Divine Fire Cover over her; nine fire dragons coiled around her, and the flames burned her back into her original form — a rock that had become a spirit. Taiyi then warned Nezha that his parents were in danger.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Returning his bones to his father and his flesh to his mother
beats.textZh: 原来东海龙王敖光不甘心，约了南海、西海、北海三位龙王，一起上奏玉帝。玉帝准奏，四海龙王来到陈塘关，把李靖和殷夫人拿住，要带上天去问罪。哪吒赶回关前，看见父母被绑，大叫一声：一人做事一人当！打死敖丙、李艮的是我，与我父母无关。我身上的骨肉是父母所生，今天我剖腹、剜肠、剔骨，还给父母，不连累双亲，你们看行不行？敖光说：你若肯这样，就救了你父母的性命。于是哪吒右手提剑，先砍下一只臂膊，然后剖开肚腹、剜出肠子、剔去骨肉，散了七魂三魄，一命归泉。四海龙王见此，放了李靖夫妇，各自回去。殷夫人把哪吒的尸体收殓起来，痛哭不止。
beats.textEn: Ao Guang had gathered the dragon kings of the southern, western and northern seas, and with the Jade Emperor's warrant they seized Li Jing and Lady Yin. Nezha cried out: one person's deed is one person's to answer for. Since his bones and flesh came from his parents, he would cut open his belly, tear out his entrails, strip his bones and return them, so that his parents would not suffer. When the dragon kings agreed, he took his sword and did so, and his soul departed. The dragon kings released his parents, and Lady Yin buried him in tears.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 哪吒的魂魄飘飘荡荡，来到乾元山。太乙真人说：你回陈塘关，托梦给你母亲，叫她在离关四十里的翠屏山上给你盖一座行宫，受三年香火，你就可以重返人间。殷夫人连做几夜的梦，瞒着李靖派人在翠屏山盖了一座哪吒行宫，塑了金身。行宫建成后十分灵验，四方百姓都来烧香，求什么应什么。半年以后，李靖操兵路过翠屏山，看见香客络绎不绝，一问才知是哪吒的行宫。他大怒：这逆子生前害我，死后还要愚弄百姓！他拿鞭子把哪吒的金身打得粉碎，又放一把火烧了行宫，还责怪了殷夫人。哪吒的魂魄回到庙里，只见一片焦土，从此对父亲怀恨在心。
beats.textEn: Nezha's soul drifted to his teacher, who told him to appear in his mother's dreams and ask for a shrine on Cuiping Mountain, forty li from the pass; after three years of incense he could return to the world. Lady Yin secretly built the shrine and a gilded statue, and it answered the prayers of all who came. Six months later Li Jing rode by with his troops, saw the crowds, and in fury smashed the statue with his whip and burned the shrine. Returning to find only ashes, Nezha's spirit bore a grudge against his father.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 太乙真人叫金霞童子到五莲池摘两枝莲花、三片荷叶来。他把荷叶铺成天、地、人三才，把莲花的梗折成三百骨节，用荷叶按上中下分成三才，再放一粒金丹在中间，用先天之法、运九转之功，把哪吒的魂魄往莲花荷叶里一推，喝声：“哪吒不成人形，更待何时！”只听一声响，跳起一个人来：面如傅粉，唇似涂朱，眼运精光，身长一丈六尺，这就是哪吒的莲花化身。真人又传他火尖枪的枪法，赐给他一对风火二轮、一个金砖，还有一只豹皮囊，把乾坤圈、混天绫和金砖都装在里面。
beats.textEn: Taiyi had his servant fetch two lotus flowers and three lotus leaves from the Five-Lotus Pond. He laid the leaves out as heaven, earth and humanity, broke the lotus stems into three hundred joints for bones, set a golden elixir pill at the centre, and pushed Nezha's soul into the lotus with a shout. Up sprang a youth with a face like powder and lips like cinnabar, sixteen feet tall: Nezha reborn in a lotus body. His teacher taught him the fire-tipped spear and gave him the wind-and-fire wheels, a golden brick, and a leopard-skin bag to hold his ring and sash.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Father against son, and the golden pagoda
beats.textZh: 哪吒踏着风火轮，提着火尖枪，直奔陈塘关找李靖算账。李靖抵挡不住，骑马逃走，一路被追得狼狈不堪。他的二儿子木吒拦住哪吒，被哪吒一金砖打倒；兄长的师父们出面相劝，哪吒仍不肯罢休。危急之时，燃灯道人出现了。他把一座玲珑宝塔交给李靖，又把哪吒罩进塔里，塔中发出火来，把哪吒烧得连连求饶，只好答应认李靖为父。燃灯道人把宝塔赐给李靖，叮嘱他：哪吒若再不服，就把宝塔祭起来烧他。从此李靖手托宝塔，人称“托塔天王”。后来父子三人都投奔西岐，辅佐周武王伐纣。
beats.textEn: Riding his wind-and-fire wheels with the fire-tipped spear, Nezha stormed Chentang Pass in pursuit of his father. Li Jing fled; his second son Muzha tried to stop Nezha and was felled by the golden brick, and other immortals urged peace in vain. At last the Daoist Randeng gave Li Jing an exquisite golden pagoda and trapped Nezha inside it, where fire burned him until he agreed to acknowledge Li Jing as his father. Li Jing kept the pagoda — hence his title, the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King — and father and sons later joined the Zhou cause.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)
beats.uncertaintyNote: 追赶途中几位师长出面的细节较多，此处只概述；燃灯赐塔与“托塔天王”之名见第十四回。

facts.textZh: 哪吒——称号：哪吒三太子 — third prince, son of Heavenly King Li
facts.textEn: In chapter 4 Nezha appears as the third prince who accompanies Heavenly King Li, the pagoda-bearer, against Sun Wukong.
facts.sourceLocation: ch. 4 (托塔李天王與哪吒三太子)

facts.textZh: 哪吒出现在“哪吒大战孙悟空（《西游记》第四回）”之中。
facts.textEn: Nezha is sent with Heavenly King Li to capture the self-styled Great Sage.

facts.textZh: 哪吒——化形：three heads and six arms
facts.textEn: Nezha shouts and changes into a figure with three heads and six arms, a weapon in each hand.
facts.sourceLocation: ch. 4, combat with the Great Sage

facts.textZh: 孙悟空击败了哪吒。
facts.textEn: Wukong plucks a hair to make a double that keeps fighting, circles behind Nezha with his true body and strikes him; Nezha retreats in pain.

deityStoryCards.name: Tathāgata Buddha (Journey to the West)
deityStoryCards.hookEn: The novel's character Rulai, who wagers with Sun Wukong and pins him under the Mountain of Five Elements; kept separate from historical and doctrinal accounts of the Buddha.

beats.headingEn: A stone gives birth to a monkey
beats.textZh: 东胜神洲傲来国的海外，有一座花果山，山顶上立着一块仙石。这块石头高三丈六尺五寸，围圆二丈四尺，自开天辟地以来就吸收着天地的灵气和日月的精华，久而久之有了灵通。有一天，仙石崩裂，生出一枚石卵，石卵被风一吹，化成一只石猴，五官俱全，四肢皆备。石猴学会了爬和走，向四方拜了一拜，两只眼睛里射出两道金光，直冲天上的斗府。玉皇大帝被惊动，派千里眼和顺风耳打开南天门查看。两位神将回报说：那是花果山上仙石生出的一只猴子，如今他吃了东西、喝了水，金光就要渐渐消退了。玉帝听了说：下方之物，都是天地精华所生，不足为奇。——谁也没想到，这只猴子后来会把天宫闹得天翻地覆。
beats.textEn: Beyond the sea from the land of Aolai on the Eastern Continent stands the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, and on its summit an immortal stone that had absorbed the essences of heaven and earth since the world began. One day it split open and released a stone egg; touched by the wind, the egg became a stone monkey. He bowed to the four quarters and beams of golden light shot from his eyes to the palace of the Pole Star. The Jade Emperor sent Thousand-Mile Eye and Wind-Following Ear to look; told it was only a monkey born of a stone, he declared such things unremarkable.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: King of the Water Curtain Cave
beats.textZh: 石猴在山中和群猴一起玩耍，饿了吃草木果实，渴了喝山涧泉水。一个炎热的夏天，群猴在涧中洗澡，想去看看这股水从哪里来，便顺着山涧往上爬，一直找到一道大瀑布前。群猴拍手说：谁能钻进瀑布，找到源头又不伤身体，我们就拜他为王！石猴应声而出，闭上眼睛纵身一跳，竟穿过了瀑布。瀑布后面是一座铁板桥，桥那边是一处天造地设的洞府，石锅石灶、石床石凳一应俱全，石碣上刻着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”。石猴跳出来把群猴都领了进去，群猴依约向他跪拜，称他为“美猴王”。从此他去掉“石”字，自称“千岁大王”，在水帘洞里过了三五百年自在的日子。
beats.textEn: The monkey played among the other monkeys of the mountain. One hot summer they followed a stream up to a great waterfall and promised to make king whoever could pass through it unharmed. The stone monkey shut his eyes and leapt through. Behind the falling water lay an iron bridge and a cave-home furnished by nature with stone pots, beds and benches, and an inscription naming it the Water Curtain Cave of the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. He led the monkeys inside, they bowed to him as the Handsome Monkey King, and he lived there freely for three or five hundred years.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 有一天，美猴王和群猴正在饮宴，他忽然流下泪来。群猴问他为何烦恼，他说：我们现在虽然不受人间王法管束，也不怕飞禽走兽，可将来年老血衰，暗中有阎王老子管着，一旦死去，岂不白白在世上走了一遭？群猴听了，也都掩面悲啼。这时一只通背猿猴跳出来说：大王能想到这一层，就是道心开发了。五虫之中，只有三等名色不归阎王管——就是佛、仙与神圣，他们躲过轮回，与天地山川同寿。美猴王大喜，决心云游海角，去寻访这三等人物，学一个长生不老的法子。第二天，群猴摘来仙桃异果为他送行，他独自砍了松木扎成木筏，拿一根竹竿当篙，漂洋过海而去。
beats.textEn: One day at a feast the Monkey King suddenly wept. Though no human law ruled them and no beast threatened them, he said, one day they would grow old and the King of the Dead would claim them. An old gibbon told him that only buddhas, immortals and sages escape the wheel of rebirth. Overjoyed, the Monkey King resolved to find them and learn the way to live forever. The next morning the monkeys feasted him with fruit, and he set off alone across the ocean on a raft of pine logs with a bamboo pole.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: The Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars
beats.textZh: 木筏被风吹到南赡部洲。美猴王上岸学人说话、穿人衣服，在市井里走了八九年，看到的都是为名为利奔忙的人，没有一个修仙的。他又扎筏渡过西洋大海，来到西牛贺洲。在一座高山上，他听见一个樵夫唱着仙家的歌，樵夫说歌是邻居一位神仙教的，那位神仙住在灵台方寸山，斜月三星洞，名叫须菩提祖师。美猴王找到洞门，等了半天，一个仙童开门迎他进去。祖师问他姓什么，他说“我无性，人若骂我，我也不恼”；又问籍贯，他说从东胜神洲来。祖师看他像个猢狲，便把“猢狲”去掉兽旁，给他姓“孙”，再按门中“广大智慧真如性海颖悟圆觉”十二字排到“悟”字，取名“孙悟空”。
beats.textEn: The raft carried him to the Southern Continent, where for eight or nine years he learned human speech and dress but met only people chasing fame and profit. Crossing another ocean to the Western Continent, he heard a woodcutter singing an immortal's song and was directed to the Patriarch Subodhi of the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars on the Mountain of Mind. The patriarch, seeing a monkey (husun), gave him the surname Sun by removing the animal radical, and from the generation character wu named him Sun Wukong, 'Awakened to Emptiness'.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A secret lesson at the third watch
beats.textZh: 悟空在洞中扫地、挑水、砍柴，一住就是六七年。有一天祖师登坛讲道，问他想学什么：讲术、流、静、动各门，可以请仙问卜、读经念佛、打坐参禅、采阴补阳，悟空每听一门都先问一句“能长生吗”，听说不能，就一概不学。祖师假装发怒，跳下高台，拿戒尺在他头上打了三下，背着手走进里屋，关上了中门。众师兄都埋怨他，悟空却心里明白：打三下，是叫他三更时分去；背着手进去、关中门，是叫他从后门进来。当夜三更，他果然从后门溜进祖师卧房跪下。祖师见他领悟了哑谜，便把长生妙道的口诀传给他。三年之后，祖师又说修成的人每五百年要遭雷灾、火灾、风灾，便教他躲灾的七十二般地煞变化；后来又传他一个筋斗云，一翻就是十万八千里。
beats.textEn: Wukong swept, fetched water and cut wood for six or seven years. When the patriarch offered him various arts, he refused each because none brought eternal life. Feigning anger, the patriarch struck him three times on the head, clasped his hands behind his back and shut the inner door. Wukong understood the riddle: come at the third watch, by the back door. That night the patriarch taught him the secret of long life, later the seventy-two earthly transformations to escape the calamities that strike immortals every five hundred years, and finally the somersault cloud that carries him 108,000 li in a single leap.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 一天傍晚，众师兄围着悟空，要看他学来的变化。悟空经不住夸，捻着诀念动咒语，摇身一变，就变成一棵松树，众人齐声喝彩。吵闹声惊动了祖师，祖师把悟空叫来责备：修行之人不可在人前卖弄，别人见了要求你，你不教就会招来祸患。他命悟空立刻离开，并且叮嘱：此去无论惹出什么祸来，都不许说是我的徒弟，你只要说出半个字来，我就把你神魂贬在九幽之处。悟空含泪拜别，一个筋斗回到花果山。他得知一个混世魔王趁他不在，霸占了水帘洞、掳走了小猴，便找上门去，拔一把毫毛变出几百个小猴，把魔王打死，夺回了洞府。
beats.textEn: One evening his fellow students begged to see his new powers, and Wukong turned himself into a pine tree to their loud applause. The patriarch, disturbed by the noise, rebuked him: an adept must not show off, for others will covet the art and trouble will follow. He sent Wukong away at once, forbidding him ever to name his teacher. Wukong somersaulted home, found that a Demon King of Confusion had seized his cave, plucked a handful of hairs that became hundreds of little monkeys, and killed the demon.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A weapon from the Dragon King
beats.textZh: 悟空操练群猴，却没有一件称手的兵器。他得知花果山下的铁板桥直通东海龙宫，便捻着闭水诀钻进水里，向东海龙王敖广讨兵器。龙王先后拿出一把大刀、一柄重三千六百斤的九股叉、一杆重七千二百斤的方天画戟，悟空都嫌太轻。龙婆、龙女出主意说：海藏里那块天河定底的神珍铁，这几天霞光艳艳，莫非是该出世遇此圣人？悟空过去一看，是一根斗来粗、二丈多长的铁柱，两头是金箍，中间刻着“如意金箍棒，重一万三千五百斤”。他说声“再短细些”，铁棒就随心变小，最后成了绣花针大小，藏进耳朵里。他又逼着四海龙王凑出藕丝步云履、锁子黄金甲和凤翅紫金冠，才心满意足地回山。
beats.textEn: Needing a weapon, Wukong dived to the Crystal Palace of Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea. A broadsword, a nine-pronged fork of 3,600 pounds and a halberd of 7,200 pounds were all too light. The Dragon Queen suggested the divine iron that had fixed the depth of the Milky Way, which had lately been glowing. It was a pillar inscribed 'Compliant Golden-Hooped Rod, weight 13,500 pounds', and it shrank at his command until it was the size of an embroidery needle, which he kept behind his ear. He then bullied the dragon kings of the four seas into giving him cloud-walking shoes, golden mail and a phoenix-feather cap.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Striking out the Register of Death
beats.textZh: 悟空回山后，又与牛魔王等六位妖王结为兄弟，天天宴饮。一天他喝醉了，在松树下睡着，梦见两个人拿着勾魂的牌子，用绳子套住他的魂魄，一直拉到幽冥界。悟空看见城上写着“幽冥界”，大怒道：我老孙早已超出三界之外，跳出五行之中，凭什么来勾我？他从耳中掏出金箍棒，把两个勾死人打成肉酱，一路打进森罗殿。十殿阎王只好叫判官拿出生死簿给他看。悟空翻到“魂字一千三百五十号”，上面写着“孙悟空，天产石猴，该寿三百四十二岁，善终”。他索性拿笔把自己和猴类的名字一概勾掉，扔下簿子打出幽冥界。醒来后，东海龙王和地府的秦广王先后上表天庭，状告这只妖猴。
beats.textEn: After a drunken feast with six demon kings, Wukong dreamed that two summoners roped his soul and dragged it to the Land of Darkness. Furious — had he not passed beyond the Three Realms? — he beat them to pulp with his staff and stormed the palace of the Ten Kings of the Underworld. There he found his own entry, 'Sun Wukong, stone monkey born of heaven, allotted 342 years, to die a good death', and with a brush struck out his name and those of all monkeys. When he woke, the Dragon King and the King Qinguang of the underworld each sent complaints to heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingZh: 天庭的第一份官职：弼马温
beats.headingEn: Heaven's first office: Keeper of the Horses
beats.textZh: 玉帝看了两道表文，正要派兵捉拿，太白金星出班奏道：这猴子是天地育成之体，不如降一道招安圣旨，把他宣上天来，给他一个官职，拘束在此，若他受天命，以后再加升赏；若违天命，就地擒拿。玉帝准奏。悟空欢喜上天，被封为御马监的弼马温。他尽心尽力，半个月里把天马养得肉肥膘满。一天同僚设宴，他问起弼马温是几品官，众人说：这官没有品从，叫作“未入流”，养得好不过是一声“好”，养瘦了还要受罚。悟空听了大怒：老孙在花果山称王称祖，怎么骗我来替他养马！他推倒公案，掣出铁棒，一路打出南天门，回到花果山。独角鬼王献上赭黄袍，劝他索性做个“齐天大圣”。
beats.textEn: As the Jade Emperor prepared to send troops, the Gold Star of Venus advised him to summon the monkey with a decree of amnesty and keep him in heaven under a title. Wukong happily accepted and was appointed Keeper of the Heavenly Horses, tending them so well that they grew sleek within a fortnight. At a banquet he learned that the post had no rank at all. Enraged at having been tricked into grooming horses, he overturned his desk, fought his way out through the Southern Gate and returned home, where a demon king urged him to proclaim himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 悟空在洞门外竖起一面大旗，上书“齐天大圣”四个大字。玉帝派托塔李天王和哪吒三太子带领天兵下界捉拿。先锋巨灵神挥着宣花斧上阵，被悟空一棒打断斧柄，败回营中。哪吒变出三头六臂，持六般兵器来战，悟空也变三头六臂，又拔一根毫毛变作本相迎敌，真身绕到背后，一棒打中哪吒的左臂，哪吒负痛败走。李天王只好收兵回奏。太白金星又出主意：不如就封他个空衔“齐天大圣”，有官无禄，养在天地之间，收他的邪心。玉帝依从，在蟠桃园右首给他盖了一座齐天大圣府，府里还设了安静司、宁神司两个衙门。悟空这才欢天喜地，在天上住了下来。
beats.textEn: Wukong raised a banner reading 'Great Sage Equal to Heaven'. The Jade Emperor sent Heavenly King Li and his son Nezha with heaven's soldiers. The vanguard, the Mighty Spirit, had his axe-handle snapped by one blow; Nezha took three heads and six arms, but Wukong did the same, sent a hair-double to fight, and struck Nezha from behind. Venus advised granting the empty title Great Sage Equal to Heaven, with no salary, to quiet the monkey's heart. A mansion was built for him beside the Peach Garden, complete with Offices of Peace and Serenity, and Wukong settled happily in heaven.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 大圣在天上无事可做，今天东游，明天西荡，和众星宿称兄道弟。许旌阳真人担心他闲中生事，玉帝便派他去管理蟠桃园。土地告诉他：园里共有三千六百株桃树——前面一千二百株，三千年一熟，人吃了成仙了道；中间一千二百株，六千年一熟，人吃了霞举飞升、长生不老；后面一千二百株，九千年一熟，人吃了与天地齐寿、日月同庚。大圣听了暗暗高兴，从此常常支开土地和力士，自己脱下冠服爬上大树，拣那熟透的大桃子吃个饱。有一天，王母娘娘要开蟠桃盛会，派七位仙女提着花篮来园中摘桃。大圣正变成二寸长的小人在树梢上睡觉，被惊醒后问仙女都请了谁，仙女一一说来，却没有他。
beats.textEn: With nothing to do, the Great Sage wandered heaven befriending stars. To keep him occupied the Jade Emperor put him in charge of the Garden of Immortal Peaches, whose 3,600 trees ripened every three, six and nine thousand years, granting immortality, eternal youth and a life as long as heaven and earth. Secretly delighted, he sent his attendants away and gorged on the ripest fruit. When seven fairy maidens came to pick peaches for the Queen Mother's Peach Banquet, they woke him from a nap in the treetops — and he learned that he had not been invited.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Stolen wine, stolen elixir and heaven's army
beats.textZh: 大圣用定身法把七位仙女定在树下，驾云直奔瑶池。宴席已经摆好，他拔毫毛变出瞌睡虫，叫造酒的力士都睡着了，自己端起玉液琼浆喝了个酩酊大醉。醉醺醺的他走错了路，闯进太上老君的兜率宫，宫中无人，只见丹房里摆着五个葫芦，装满炼好的金丹。他想：这是仙家至宝，我且尝尝。于是把葫芦里的金丹倒出来，像吃炒豆一样全吃了。酒醒之后，他知道闯了大祸，连忙逃出西天门，回到花果山。玉帝大怒，派四大天王、李天王、哪吒，率领二十八宿、九曜星官、十二元辰等十万天兵，布下十八架天罗地网围住花果山。大圣带着群猴迎战，一连打败九曜星和四大天王，到天黑也没有被捉住。
beats.textEn: Freezing the fairies with an immobilising spell, the Great Sage flew to the Jade Pool, put the wine-makers to sleep with sleep-insects made from his hairs and drank himself senseless. Staggering the wrong way, he wandered into Laozi's Tushita Palace and ate the five gourds of finished elixir pills as if they were roasted beans. Sobering in alarm, he fled home. The Jade Emperor sent the Four Heavenly Kings, Heavenly King Li, Nezha, the twenty-eight lunar mansions and the nine planets with a hundred thousand soldiers and eighteen nets around the mountain, yet the Great Sage held them off until nightfall.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 观音菩萨赴蟠桃会，听说此事，先派徒弟惠岸行者下界交战，也败了回来。观音便向玉帝推荐玉帝的外甥——住在灌江口的显圣二郎真君。二郎神带着梅山六兄弟和哮天犬来到花果山，和大圣大战三百余回合，不分胜负，各自变成万丈高的法身相斗。猴群溃散，大圣心慌，收了法相变成一只麻雀飞上树梢；二郎就变成饿鹰去扑他。大圣变成大鹚老冲天飞去，二郎变成海鹤追赶；他变鱼钻进水里，二郎变鱼鹰候着；他变水蛇，二郎变灰鹤；他变成一只低贱的花鸨，二郎不屑追，用弹弓把他打落。大圣滚到山崖下又变成一座土地庙，嘴变庙门，牙变门扇，舌头变菩萨，尾巴没处放，竖在后面变成一根旗杆，被二郎一眼识破。最后太上老君在云端丢下金刚琢，正打在大圣头上，哮天犬扑上来咬住他的腿，大圣才被众神按倒擒住。
beats.textEn: Guanyin recommended the Jade Emperor's nephew, the Illustrious Sage Erlang of Guanjiang. With his six sworn brothers and his celestial hound, Erlang fought the Great Sage for over three hundred rounds. When the monkeys scattered, the Great Sage fled through transformation after transformation — sparrow, cormorant, fish, water snake, bustard — and Erlang matched each as hawk, crane, osprey and grey crane. Disguised as a temple, the monkey could not hide his tail and stood it up behind as a flagpole, which gave him away. At last Laozi dropped his Diamond Snare on his head, the hound bit his leg, and he was seized.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Fiery golden eyes in the Eight Trigrams furnace
beats.textZh: 大圣被押到斩妖台，绑在降妖柱上。天兵刀砍斧剁、枪刺剑刳，火部众神放火烧、雷部众神用雷劈，竟伤不了他一根毫毛。太上老君说：这猴子吃了蟠桃、喝了御酒，又盗吃了我的金丹，炼成了金刚之躯。不如交给我，放进八卦炉里，用文武火锻炼，炼出我的丹来，他的身体自然化为灰烬。大圣被推进八卦炉，他钻进巽宫位下——巽是风，有风就没有火，只是被烟熏红了眼睛，从此有了一双“火眼金睛”。四十九天后，老君开炉取丹，大圣忽地跳了出来，一脚蹬倒八卦炉，炉砖带着火掉落凡间。他掏出金箍棒，从兜率宫一路打到灵霄殿外，九曜星闭门闭户，四天王无影无踪，只有王灵官举着金鞭拦住了他。
beats.textEn: Bound at the execution terrace, the Great Sage could not be hurt by sword, axe, fire or thunder: the peaches, wine and elixir had made his body adamantine. Laozi had him placed in his Eight Trigrams furnace to be refined for forty-nine days. Hiding under the trigram of wind, where there is no fire, he was only smoked — which reddened his eyes into 'fiery golden eyes'. When the furnace was opened he sprang out, kicked it over so that its burning bricks fell to earth, and fought his way to the Hall of Divine Mists, where only the officer Wang Lingguan stood against him.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 王灵官和三十六员雷将把大圣团团围住，大圣变出三头六臂，把金箍棒幌一幌变成三根，六只手使开，打得雷将们近不了身。玉帝只好派游弈灵官和翊圣真君到西方去请如来佛祖。如来来到灵霄殿外，叫雷将停手，问大圣：你有什么本事，敢夺玉帝的尊位？大圣说：“皇帝轮流做，明年到我家”，只要玉帝把天宫让给他就罢了。如来笑道：我和你打个赌——你若一个筋斗翻得出我的右手掌，就算你赢，请玉帝到西方居住，天宫让给你；若翻不出去，你就回下界做妖，再修几劫来争。大圣暗笑：我一个筋斗十万八千里，他的手掌不满一尺，怎么跳不出去？他跳上佛掌，一个筋斗云不见踪影，只见天边立着五根肉红柱子，便以为到了天的尽头。
beats.textEn: Surrounded by Wang Lingguan and thirty-six thunder generals, the Great Sage fought them off with three heads, six arms and three staffs, until the Jade Emperor sent to the West for Rulai. Asked what right he had to the throne, the Great Sage replied that emperors take turns — next year it would be his. Rulai offered a wager: if he could somersault out of Rulai's right palm, the Jade Emperor would yield heaven; if not, he must return below. Scoffing that his somersault covered 108,000 li, the Great Sage leapt — and came to five flesh-pink pillars he took to be the edge of the sky.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Under the Mountain of Five Elements
beats.textZh: 大圣心想：我到了这里，回去跟如来做个凭证。他拔一根毫毛变出一支浓墨双毫笔，在中间那根柱子上写下一行大字：“齐天大圣到此一游”。写完收了毫毛，又不庄重地在第一根柱子下撒了一泡猴尿，然后翻转筋斗回到原处，对如来说：我已经去了又回来了，你叫玉帝让出天宫吧！如来骂道：你这尿精猴子，你正好不曾离开我的手掌！你低头看看。大圣一看，如来右手中指上写着“齐天大圣到此一游”，大拇指根下还有一股猴尿的臊气。他大吃一惊，正要再跳，被如来翻掌一扑，推出西天门外，五根手指化作金、木、水、火、土五座相连的大山，叫作“五行山”，把他压在山下。众神在天宫摆了“安天大会”答谢如来。如来又取出写着“唵、嘛、呢、叭、咪、吽”六个金字的帖子，贴在山顶，并嘱咐当地的土地神：他饿了就给他吃铁丸子，渴了就给他喝熔化的铜汁。等他的灾难满了，自然会有人来救他。——这一压，就是五百年。
beats.textEn: To prove his journey he made a brush from a hair, wrote 'The Great Sage Equal to Heaven was here' on the middle pillar, and relieved himself at the foot of the first. Somersaulting back, he demanded the throne. Rulai showed him the words written on his own middle finger and the smell of monkey urine at the base of his thumb. Before the monkey could leap again, Rulai pushed him out of the Western Gate and turned his five fingers into the five joined peaks of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth — the Mountain of Five Elements — sealed with a golden six-syllable charm. The local god was to feed him iron pellets and molten copper until, five hundred years later, someone would come to free him.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)
beats.uncertaintyNote: “五百年”的时间与后来唐僧解救的情节见于第八回之后，本篇只讲到被压为止。

deityStoryCards.name: Li Jing, the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King
deityStoryCards.hookEn: Commander of Chentang Pass and Nezha's father in Investiture of the Gods, who receives the golden pagoda that gives him his title; in Journey to the West he leads heaven's army.

beats.textZh: 商朝末年，陈塘关的总兵李靖，曾经拜西昆仑度厄真人为师，学过五行遁术，后来因为仙道难成，下山辅佐纣王，做了镇守一方的总兵。他的夫人殷氏已经生了两个儿子：长子金吒、次子木吒。不料殷夫人第三次怀孕，竟怀了三年零六个月还没有生产。李靖常常对着夫人发愁：怀胎这么久，恐怕不是吉兆。一天夜里，殷夫人梦见一位道人径直走进卧房，说了一声“夫人快接麟儿”，就把一样东西往她怀里一送。夫人猛然惊醒，腹中随即疼痛起来，李靖连忙出去在前厅等候。
beats.textEn: In the last years of the Shang, Li Jing, commander of Chentang Pass, had once studied the arts of the Five Elements with an immortal before coming down the mountain to serve King Zhou. His wife, Lady Yin, had borne two sons, Jinzha and Muzha, but her third pregnancy lasted three years and six months, and Li Jing feared it was an ill omen. One night she dreamed that a Daoist walked into her chamber, said 'Madam, receive your unicorn child', and thrust something into her arms. She woke with labour pains.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A child from a ball of flesh
beats.textZh: 两个侍女慌慌张张跑来报告：夫人生下了一个妖精！李靖急忙提剑进房，只见满屋红光，异香扑鼻，地上一个肉球滴溜溜地乱转。李靖大惊，一剑砍去，肉球分开，跳出一个小孩来：遍体红光，面如傅粉，右手套着一只金镯，肚腹上围着一块红绫，金光射目。这就是乾坤圈和混天绫。孩子满地乱跑，李靖看他相貌可爱，不忍心杀他，抱给夫人看，夫妻俩都十分喜爱。第二天，许多属官都来道贺。
beats.textEn: Maids ran out crying that their mistress had given birth to a monster. Li Jing rushed in with his sword: the room glowed red and smelled of strange perfume, and a ball of flesh was spinning on the floor. He split it with one stroke, and out jumped a little boy glowing red, his face as white as powder, a golden bracelet on his right arm and a red silk sash around his belly flashing golden light — the Universe Ring and the Red Armillary Sash. Charmed despite himself, Li Jing could not bring himself to kill the child.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 第三天，门官来报：外面有一位道人求见。李靖出门迎接，来的是乾元山金光洞的太乙真人。真人说：听说将军生了一位公子，贫道特来贺喜，能否让我看一看？李靖叫人把孩子抱出来。真人看了问：这孩子是什么时辰生的？李靖说是丑时。真人道：不好。原来这孩子是“灵珠子”化身，生在丑时，犯了一千七百条杀戒。他问孩子起了名字没有，李靖说还没有。真人说：我给他起个名字，就叫“哪吒”，收他做我的徒弟，你看如何？李靖连连答应。真人又叮嘱了几句，便告辞回山。
beats.textEn: On the third day a Daoist called: Taiyi Zhenren of the Golden Light Cave on Qianyuan Mountain. Looking at the baby, he asked the hour of birth; told it was the hour of the ox, he said that was unlucky, for the child — an incarnation of the Spirit Pearl — would break the commandment against killing seventeen hundred times. He named the boy Nezha and took him as his disciple, and Li Jing gladly agreed.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Bathing in the Nine Bends River
beats.textZh: 光阴似箭，哪吒长到七岁，身高六尺。这年五月天气炎热，他向母亲禀明，带着一个家将出关游玩。走到一条清澈的九湾河边，他见河水碧绿，便脱了衣服坐在石头上，把七尺长的混天绫放进水里蘸着洗澡。谁知这混天绫是一件宝物，在水里一摆，河水就映红了；再一摆，江河晃动；摇一摇，天地都跟着动。九湾河连着东海，这一洗，东海龙王敖光的水晶宫被晃得乱响，几乎要塌了。
beats.textEn: At seven years old and six feet tall, Nezha went outside the pass one hot day in the fifth month with a servant. At the clear Nine Bends River he sat on a rock and dipped his seven-foot Red Armillary Sash in the water to bathe. But the sash was a treasure: one swish turned the river red, another shook the waters, and further shaking moved heaven and earth. The river flowed into the Eastern Sea, and the Crystal Palace of the Dragon King Ao Guang shook as if it would collapse.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: The yaksha and the third prince
beats.textZh: 龙王派巡海夜叉李艮去看看出了什么事。夜叉分开水面，看见一个小孩在用红绫洗澡，便张口大骂，提起斧头就劈。哪吒闪过，把右手上的乾坤圈往空中一丢，正打在夜叉头上，夜叉脑浆迸流，死在岸上。哪吒还笑着说：把我的乾坤圈都弄脏了。龙王的三太子敖丙听说夜叉被打死，骑着逼水兽，带着虾兵蟹将杀出水面。两人言语不合，敖丙举戟就刺，哪吒把混天绫往空中一展，像一团火块把敖丙裹下兽来，又一乾坤圈打在他的头顶。三太子现出龙的原形，死在岸边。哪吒说：这条龙的筋，正好抽出来给我父亲做一条束甲的绦子。于是把龙筋抽了出来。
beats.textEn: The Dragon King sent the patrolling yaksha Li Gen to investigate. The yaksha cursed the boy and swung his axe; Nezha threw his Universe Ring and killed him with one blow, laughing that the ring was now dirty. The Dragon King's third son, Ao Bing, rode out on a water-parting beast with an army of shrimps and crabs. When he thrust with his halberd, Nezha's sash wrapped him like fire and pulled him down, and the ring struck his head. Ao Bing died in his dragon form, and Nezha pulled out the dragon's sinew to make a belt for his father's armour.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 哪吒回到家里，若无其事。东海龙王敖光得知儿子被杀、龙筋被抽，悲痛万分，化成一个秀士来到陈塘关，要李靖交出凶手。李靖起初不信，说我的儿子才七岁，怎能做出这种事？他到后园去问，哪吒正坐在那里编龙筋绦子，坦然承认，还说是对方先骂人动手。李靖惊得目瞪口呆。敖光看见儿子的龙筋，更加悲愤，说：明天我就上奏玉帝，问你们父子的罪！说完就走了。殷夫人和李靖相对痛哭，哪吒见父母为难，跪下说：这事我自己去承担，我去乾元山问我的师父。
beats.textEn: Ao Guang, grieving for his son, came to Chentang Pass in the form of a scholar and demanded the killer. Li Jing could not believe a seven-year-old had done it, but found Nezha in the back garden calmly braiding the dragon sinew into a belt, readily admitting the deed. The sight enraged the Dragon King, who vowed to report father and son to the Jade Emperor the next day. As his parents wept, Nezha knelt and said he would take responsibility himself and seek his teacher's counsel.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Beating the Dragon King at the Gate of Treasured Virtue
beats.textZh: 哪吒借土遁到乾元山，向太乙真人说明经过。真人想：这是天数注定，并非他有意为之。他让哪吒解开衣服，在他胸前画了一道隐身符，叫他到天上的宝德门外等候龙王。哪吒到了宝德门，天宫的门还没开，他隐着身子等。不一会儿，敖光朝服叮当地来了，哪吒看得见他，他却看不见哪吒。哪吒冲上去，一乾坤圈把他打倒，用脚踏住他的后背，又揭开他的朝服，从左胁下一连揭了四五十片龙鳞，鲜血直流。敖光疼痛难忍，只好求饶，答应不再上告。哪吒叫他变成一条小青蛇，装进袖子里，带回陈塘关去见父亲。
beats.textEn: Nezha travelled underground to his teacher. Taiyi judged the matter fated rather than wilful, drew an invisibility charm on the boy's chest, and sent him to wait outside the Gate of Treasured Virtue in heaven. When Ao Guang arrived in his court robes, unable to see his attacker, Nezha knocked him down with the ring, stood on his back and tore forty or fifty scales from beneath his left ribs. In agony, the Dragon King promised not to complain, and Nezha made him shrink into a little green snake and carried him home in his sleeve.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)
beats.uncertaintyNote: 宝德门一段跨第十二、十三回回末与回首，各刻本分回处略有出入。

beats.headingEn: An arrow kills the Green Cloud boy
beats.textZh: 龙王放回后，怀恨而去。哪吒无事，又到陈塘关的城楼上玩耍，看见架上放着一张乾坤弓和三支震天箭——这是轩辕黄帝传下来的镇关之宝，从来没人拉得开。哪吒拿起来，一拉就开，搭箭向西南方射去。这一箭直飞到骷髅山白骨洞，正射中石矶娘娘门下的碧云童子，童子当场死去。石矶娘娘拔出箭来，见箭上刻着“镇陈塘关总兵李靖”，大怒，驾着青鸾来到陈塘关，先把李靖摄到洞中质问。李靖说明原委，回来叫哪吒去山上请罪。
beats.textEn: Freed, the Dragon King left nursing his grudge. Nezha then climbed the gate tower of the pass, where hung the Universe Bow and three Heaven-Shaking Arrows left by the Yellow Emperor, which no one had ever been able to draw. Nezha drew the bow with ease and shot an arrow to the south-west. It flew all the way to the White Bone Cave on Skull Mountain and killed the Green Cloud boy, disciple of Lady Shiji. Seeing the arrow inscribed with Li Jing's name, she seized him and demanded the culprit.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 哪吒来到骷髅山，和石矶娘娘一言不合就动起手来。石矶法力高强，用八卦云光帕把哪吒的乾坤圈和混天绫都收了去。哪吒抵挡不住，一路逃回乾元山，向师父求救。太乙真人出洞，好言相劝，石矶不肯罢休，挥剑就砍。真人说：既然你要动手，就怪不得我了。他把九龙神火罩往空中一抛，罩住石矶，九条火龙盘绕，烈焰腾腾，把石矶烧出了原形——原来她是一块天地间孕育出来的顽石成精。太乙真人对哪吒说：你快回去，你的父母已经有难了。
beats.textEn: At Skull Mountain Nezha fought Lady Shiji, who caught his ring and sash with her eight-trigram cloud-light kerchief. He fled to his teacher. When she refused to make peace and attacked with her sword, Taiyi threw his Nine-Dragon Divine Fire Cover over her; nine fire dragons coiled around her, and the flames burned her back into her original form — a rock that had become a spirit. Taiyi then warned Nezha that his parents were in danger.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Returning his bones to his father and his flesh to his mother
beats.textZh: 原来东海龙王敖光不甘心，约了南海、西海、北海三位龙王，一起上奏玉帝。玉帝准奏，四海龙王来到陈塘关，把李靖和殷夫人拿住，要带上天去问罪。哪吒赶回关前，看见父母被绑，大叫一声：一人做事一人当！打死敖丙、李艮的是我，与我父母无关。我身上的骨肉是父母所生，今天我剖腹、剜肠、剔骨，还给父母，不连累双亲，你们看行不行？敖光说：你若肯这样，就救了你父母的性命。于是哪吒右手提剑，先砍下一只臂膊，然后剖开肚腹、剜出肠子、剔去骨肉，散了七魂三魄，一命归泉。四海龙王见此，放了李靖夫妇，各自回去。殷夫人把哪吒的尸体收殓起来，痛哭不止。
beats.textEn: Ao Guang had gathered the dragon kings of the southern, western and northern seas, and with the Jade Emperor's warrant they seized Li Jing and Lady Yin. Nezha cried out: one person's deed is one person's to answer for. Since his bones and flesh came from his parents, he would cut open his belly, tear out his entrails, strip his bones and return them, so that his parents would not suffer. When the dragon kings agreed, he took his sword and did so, and his soul departed. The dragon kings released his parents, and Lady Yin buried him in tears.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 哪吒的魂魄飘飘荡荡，来到乾元山。太乙真人说：你回陈塘关，托梦给你母亲，叫她在离关四十里的翠屏山上给你盖一座行宫，受三年香火，你就可以重返人间。殷夫人连做几夜的梦，瞒着李靖派人在翠屏山盖了一座哪吒行宫，塑了金身。行宫建成后十分灵验，四方百姓都来烧香，求什么应什么。半年以后，李靖操兵路过翠屏山，看见香客络绎不绝，一问才知是哪吒的行宫。他大怒：这逆子生前害我，死后还要愚弄百姓！他拿鞭子把哪吒的金身打得粉碎，又放一把火烧了行宫，还责怪了殷夫人。哪吒的魂魄回到庙里，只见一片焦土，从此对父亲怀恨在心。
beats.textEn: Nezha's soul drifted to his teacher, who told him to appear in his mother's dreams and ask for a shrine on Cuiping Mountain, forty li from the pass; after three years of incense he could return to the world. Lady Yin secretly built the shrine and a gilded statue, and it answered the prayers of all who came. Six months later Li Jing rode by with his troops, saw the crowds, and in fury smashed the statue with his whip and burned the shrine. Returning to find only ashes, Nezha's spirit bore a grudge against his father.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 太乙真人叫金霞童子到五莲池摘两枝莲花、三片荷叶来。他把荷叶铺成天、地、人三才，把莲花的梗折成三百骨节，用荷叶按上中下分成三才，再放一粒金丹在中间，用先天之法、运九转之功，把哪吒的魂魄往莲花荷叶里一推，喝声：“哪吒不成人形，更待何时！”只听一声响，跳起一个人来：面如傅粉，唇似涂朱，眼运精光，身长一丈六尺，这就是哪吒的莲花化身。真人又传他火尖枪的枪法，赐给他一对风火二轮、一个金砖，还有一只豹皮囊，把乾坤圈、混天绫和金砖都装在里面。
beats.textEn: Taiyi had his servant fetch two lotus flowers and three lotus leaves from the Five-Lotus Pond. He laid the leaves out as heaven, earth and humanity, broke the lotus stems into three hundred joints for bones, set a golden elixir pill at the centre, and pushed Nezha's soul into the lotus with a shout. Up sprang a youth with a face like powder and lips like cinnabar, sixteen feet tall: Nezha reborn in a lotus body. His teacher taught him the fire-tipped spear and gave him the wind-and-fire wheels, a golden brick, and a leopard-skin bag to hold his ring and sash.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: Father against son, and the golden pagoda
beats.textZh: 哪吒踏着风火轮，提着火尖枪，直奔陈塘关找李靖算账。李靖抵挡不住，骑马逃走，一路被追得狼狈不堪。他的二儿子木吒拦住哪吒，被哪吒一金砖打倒；兄长的师父们出面相劝，哪吒仍不肯罢休。危急之时，燃灯道人出现了。他把一座玲珑宝塔交给李靖，又把哪吒罩进塔里，塔中发出火来，把哪吒烧得连连求饶，只好答应认李靖为父。燃灯道人把宝塔赐给李靖，叮嘱他：哪吒若再不服，就把宝塔祭起来烧他。从此李靖手托宝塔，人称“托塔天王”。后来父子三人都投奔西岐，辅佐周武王伐纣。
beats.textEn: Riding his wind-and-fire wheels with the fire-tipped spear, Nezha stormed Chentang Pass in pursuit of his father. Li Jing fled; his second son Muzha tried to stop Nezha and was felled by the golden brick, and other immortals urged peace in vain. At last the Daoist Randeng gave Li Jing an exquisite golden pagoda and trapped Nezha inside it, where fire burned him until he agreed to acknowledge Li Jing as his father. Li Jing kept the pagoda — hence his title, the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King — and father and sons later joined the Zhou cause.
beats.sourceTitle: Investiture of the Gods (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)
beats.uncertaintyNote: 追赶途中几位师长出面的细节较多，此处只概述；燃灯赐塔与“托塔天王”之名见第十四回。

deityStoryCards.name: Jade Emperor
deityStoryCards.hookEn: Ruler of the heavenly court in Chinese popular religion; in Journey to the West he tries to appease and then subdue Sun Wukong.

beats.headingEn: A stone gives birth to a monkey
beats.textZh: 东胜神洲傲来国的海外，有一座花果山，山顶上立着一块仙石。这块石头高三丈六尺五寸，围圆二丈四尺，自开天辟地以来就吸收着天地的灵气和日月的精华，久而久之有了灵通。有一天，仙石崩裂，生出一枚石卵，石卵被风一吹，化成一只石猴，五官俱全，四肢皆备。石猴学会了爬和走，向四方拜了一拜，两只眼睛里射出两道金光，直冲天上的斗府。玉皇大帝被惊动，派千里眼和顺风耳打开南天门查看。两位神将回报说：那是花果山上仙石生出的一只猴子，如今他吃了东西、喝了水，金光就要渐渐消退了。玉帝听了说：下方之物，都是天地精华所生，不足为奇。——谁也没想到，这只猴子后来会把天宫闹得天翻地覆。
beats.textEn: Beyond the sea from the land of Aolai on the Eastern Continent stands the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, and on its summit an immortal stone that had absorbed the essences of heaven and earth since the world began. One day it split open and released a stone egg; touched by the wind, the egg became a stone monkey. He bowed to the four quarters and beams of golden light shot from his eyes to the palace of the Pole Star. The Jade Emperor sent Thousand-Mile Eye and Wind-Following Ear to look; told it was only a monkey born of a stone, he declared such things unremarkable.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: King of the Water Curtain Cave
beats.textZh: 石猴在山中和群猴一起玩耍，饿了吃草木果实，渴了喝山涧泉水。一个炎热的夏天，群猴在涧中洗澡，想去看看这股水从哪里来，便顺着山涧往上爬，一直找到一道大瀑布前。群猴拍手说：谁能钻进瀑布，找到源头又不伤身体，我们就拜他为王！石猴应声而出，闭上眼睛纵身一跳，竟穿过了瀑布。瀑布后面是一座铁板桥，桥那边是一处天造地设的洞府，石锅石灶、石床石凳一应俱全，石碣上刻着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”。石猴跳出来把群猴都领了进去，群猴依约向他跪拜，称他为“美猴王”。从此他去掉“石”字，自称“千岁大王”，在水帘洞里过了三五百年自在的日子。
beats.textEn: The monkey played among the other monkeys of the mountain. One hot summer they followed a stream up to a great waterfall and promised to make king whoever could pass through it unharmed. The stone monkey shut his eyes and leapt through. Behind the falling water lay an iron bridge and a cave-home furnished by nature with stone pots, beds and benches, and an inscription naming it the Water Curtain Cave of the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. He led the monkeys inside, they bowed to him as the Handsome Monkey King, and he lived there freely for three or five hundred years.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 有一天，美猴王和群猴正在饮宴，他忽然流下泪来。群猴问他为何烦恼，他说：我们现在虽然不受人间王法管束，也不怕飞禽走兽，可将来年老血衰，暗中有阎王老子管着，一旦死去，岂不白白在世上走了一遭？群猴听了，也都掩面悲啼。这时一只通背猿猴跳出来说：大王能想到这一层，就是道心开发了。五虫之中，只有三等名色不归阎王管——就是佛、仙与神圣，他们躲过轮回，与天地山川同寿。美猴王大喜，决心云游海角，去寻访这三等人物，学一个长生不老的法子。第二天，群猴摘来仙桃异果为他送行，他独自砍了松木扎成木筏，拿一根竹竿当篙，漂洋过海而去。
beats.textEn: One day at a feast the Monkey King suddenly wept. Though no human law ruled them and no beast threatened them, he said, one day they would grow old and the King of the Dead would claim them. An old gibbon told him that only buddhas, immortals and sages escape the wheel of rebirth. Overjoyed, the Monkey King resolved to find them and learn the way to live forever. The next morning the monkeys feasted him with fruit, and he set off alone across the ocean on a raft of pine logs with a bamboo pole.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: The Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars
beats.textZh: 木筏被风吹到南赡部洲。美猴王上岸学人说话、穿人衣服，在市井里走了八九年，看到的都是为名为利奔忙的人，没有一个修仙的。他又扎筏渡过西洋大海，来到西牛贺洲。在一座高山上，他听见一个樵夫唱着仙家的歌，樵夫说歌是邻居一位神仙教的，那位神仙住在灵台方寸山，斜月三星洞，名叫须菩提祖师。美猴王找到洞门，等了半天，一个仙童开门迎他进去。祖师问他姓什么，他说“我无性，人若骂我，我也不恼”；又问籍贯，他说从东胜神洲来。祖师看他像个猢狲，便把“猢狲”去掉兽旁，给他姓“孙”，再按门中“广大智慧真如性海颖悟圆觉”十二字排到“悟”字，取名“孙悟空”。
beats.textEn: The raft carried him to the Southern Continent, where for eight or nine years he learned human speech and dress but met only people chasing fame and profit. Crossing another ocean to the Western Continent, he heard a woodcutter singing an immortal's song and was directed to the Patriarch Subodhi of the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars on the Mountain of Mind. The patriarch, seeing a monkey (husun), gave him the surname Sun by removing the animal radical, and from the generation character wu named him Sun Wukong, 'Awakened to Emptiness'.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.headingEn: A secret lesson at the third watch
beats.textZh: 悟空在洞中扫地、挑水、砍柴，一住就是六七年。有一天祖师登坛讲道，问他想学什么：讲术、流、静、动各门，可以请仙问卜、读经念佛、打坐参禅、采阴补阳，悟空每听一门都先问一句“能长生吗”，听说不能，就一概不学。祖师假装发怒，跳下高台，拿戒尺在他头上打了三下，背着手走进里屋，关上了中门。众师兄都埋怨他，悟空却心里明白：打三下，是叫他三更时分去；背着手进去、关中门，是叫他从后门进来。当夜三更，他果然从后门溜进祖师卧房跪下。祖师见他领悟了哑谜，便把长生妙道的口诀传给他。三年之后，祖师又说修成的人每五百年要遭雷灾、火灾、风灾，便教他躲灾的七十二般地煞变化；后来又传他一个筋斗云，一翻就是十万八千里。
beats.textEn: Wukong swept, fetched water and cut wood for six or seven years. When the patriarch offered him various arts, he refused each because none brought eternal life. Feigning anger, the patriarch struck him three times on the head, clasped his hands behind his back and shut the inner door. Wukong understood the riddle: come at the third watch, by the back door. That night the patriarch taught him the secret of long life, later the seventy-two earthly transformations to escape the calamities that strike immortals every five hundred years, and finally the somersault cloud that carries him 108,000 li in a single leap.
beats.sourceTitle: Journey to the West (Wikisource transcription, 100 chapters)

beats.textZh: 一天傍晚，众师兄围着悟空，要看他学来的变化。悟空经不住夸，捻着诀念动咒语，摇身一变，就变成一棵松树，众人齐声喝彩。吵闹声惊动了祖师，祖师把悟空叫来责备：修行之人不可在人前卖弄，别人见了要求你，你不教就会招来祸患。他命悟空立刻离开，并且叮嘱：此去无论惹出什么祸来，都不许说是我的徒弟，你只要说出半个字来，我就把你神魂贬在九幽之处。悟空含泪拜别，一个筋斗回到花果山。他得知一个混世魔王趁他不在，霸占了水帘洞、掳走了小猴，便找上门去，拔一把毫毛变出几百个小猴，把魔王打死，夺回了洞府。
beats.textEn: One evening his fellow students begged to see his new powers, and Wukong turned himself into a pine tree to their loud applause. The patriarch, disturbed by the noise, rebuked him: an adept must not show off, for others will covet the art and trouble will follow. He sent Wukong away at once, forbidding him ever to name his teacher.
